local local_class = newclass('SteampunkMainSection6')

		Comment = 난민들과 함께 붙잡혀서 노역소로 끌려가는 플레이어, 죄수복을 받고 노역을 시작함. @
		Index = 5 @
		NextSections = 6 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 스테이지 이름
	self.stage_name_2 = 'steampunk_1_2'

	self.shyapira = nil

	-- 샤피라와 같이 있는 군인 NPC 리스트
	self.shyapira_soldier_list = nil

	-- 기차 연출을 위한 난민 리스트
	self.train_refugee_list = nil

	-- 붙잡힌 난민 리스트
	self.caught_refugee_list = nil

	-- 관사 앞마당의 제국병 NPC 리스트
	self.frontyard_soldier_list = nil

	-- 열정적인 난민 청년 평상복
	self.passionate_boy = nil

	-- 열정적인 난민 청년
	self.refugee_passionate_boy = nil

	-- 수용소장
	self.officer = nil

	-- 기차
	self.train = nil

	-- 기차 Interactable
	self.train_interactable = nil

	-- 프로젝타일 발사 보조 클래스
	self.shoot_helper_list = nil

	-- 프로젝타일의 중복 명중 방지 처리를 위한 플래그
	self.is_hit_player = false

	-- 기차 탑승했는지 저장
	self.ride_on_train = false

	self.shyapira_soldier_num = 4
	self.frontyard_soldier_num = 8
	self.caught_refugee_num = 7
	self.refugee_holdable_num = 6
	self.whole_soldier_num = 16
	self.whole_refugee_num = 15
	self.labor_soldier_num = 6
	self.costume_item_id = 10014
	self.pickaxe_item_id = 20133

	-- NPC 이름
	self.ishya_name = 'ishya'
	self.shyapira_name = 'shyapira'
	self.soldier_name = 'soldier_'
	self.refugee_name = 'refugee_'
	self.caught_refugee_name = 'caught_refugee_'
	self.passionate_boy_name = 'civilian_passionate_boy'
	self.refugee_passionate_boy_name = 'refugee_passionate_boy'
	self.frontyard_soldier_name = 'frontyard_soldier_'
	self.officer_name = 'officer'
	self.train_name = 'train_1'
	self.knight_male_refugee_name = 'knight_male_refugee'
	self.knight_female_refugee_name = 'knight_female_refugee'

	-- 필드오브젝트 이름

	-- 존 이름
	self.train_zone_name = 'section_6_train'

	-- 마커 이름
	self.start_marker_name = 'section_6_start'

	-- 퀘스트 마커와 트래커 이름
	self.quest_marker_name = "steampunk_main"
	self.quest_tracker_name = "steampunk_main_s6_tracker_0"

	-- 이벤트 이름
	self.on_off_interact_event_key = 'section_6'

	-- 오브젝트 풀 이름
	self.hit_effect_preset = 'FX_hit'
	self.impact_hit_effect_preset = 'FX_lasthit'

	-- 프로젝타일 이름
	self.machinegun_bullet_name = "rifle_bullet_long_dist"

	quest_icon.PreLoad()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_2 then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_projectile_preset)

		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

		self:setting()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_2 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.caught_player_event, self))
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.shyapira = nil
	self.passionate_boy = nil
	self.refugee_passionate_boy = nil
	self.officer = nil

	if self.train ~= nil then
		self.train.Interactable = self.train_interactable
		self.train = nil
		self.train_interactable = nil
	end

	self.shyapira_soldier_list = nil
	self.caught_refugee_list = nil
	self.frontyard_soldier_list = nil
	self.train_refugee_list = nil

	self.shoot_helper_list = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if e.FullLeave and e.FieldObject == user_party_leader then
		if e.Zone.Name == self.train_zone_name then
			if not self.ride_on_train then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.out_of_train_zone, self))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.train) then
		if not self.ride_on_train then
			self.ride_on_train = true
		end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.interact_with_train, self))
	end
end

-- 섹션 입장 시 NPC 설정
function local_class:setting()
	-- 플레이어 설정
	local start_marker = field:GetMarker(self.start_marker_name)

	character_util.set_position(user_party_leader, start_marker.position)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, start_marker.direction)
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'push', upper = true })

	-- NPC 설정
	self.shyapira = get_character(self.shyapira_name)
	character_util.set_position(self.shyapira, start_marker.position + vector(0, 0, 1))
	character_util.set_direction(self.shyapira, 'up')

	self.officer = get_character(self.officer_name)
	character_util.set_position(self.officer, vector(38.5, 0, 60.5))
	character_util.set_direction(self.officer, 'down')

	self.passionate_boy = get_character(self.passionate_boy_name)
	self.passionate_boy.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.set_position(self.passionate_boy, start_marker.position + vector(0, 0, -1))
	character_util.set_direction(self.passionate_boy, 'up')
	character_util.set_anim(self.passionate_boy, { name = 'push', upper = true })

	self.refugee_passionate_boy = get_character(self.refugee_passionate_boy_name)

	self.caught_refugee_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	self.train_refugee_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.caught_refugee_num do
		local cur_refugee = get_character(self.caught_refugee_name..i)

		if i <= 2 then
			cur_refugee.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
			character_util.set_position(cur_refugee, start_marker.position + vector(0, 0, -1 - i))
			character_util.set_direction(cur_refugee, 'up')
			character_util.set_anim(cur_refugee, { name = 'push', upper = true })

			self.caught_refugee_list:Add(cur_refugee)
		else
			self.train_refugee_list:Add(cur_refugee)
		end
	end

	self.shyapira_soldier_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.shyapira_soldier_num do
		local val = math.floor((i-1) / 2)
		local mod = i % 2

		local cur_soldier = get_character(self.soldier_name..i)

		if mod == 0 then
			character_util.set_position(cur_soldier, start_marker.position + vector(-0.5, 0, -4 - val))
		else
			character_util.set_position(cur_soldier, start_marker.position + vector(0.5, 0, -4 - val))
		end

		character_util.set_direction(cur_soldier, 'up')

		self.shyapira_soldier_list:Add(cur_soldier)
	end

	self.frontyard_soldier_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)
	for i = 1, self.frontyard_soldier_num do
		self.frontyard_soldier_list:Add(get_character(self.frontyard_soldier_name..i))
	end

	self.train = get_character(self.train_name)
	self.train_interactable = self.train.Interactable
	self.train.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	-- 프로젝타일 발사 관련 처리
	local basic_rifle_id = 9030011;
	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData');
	local rifle_data = item_data:GetSpec(basic_rifle_id).Data;
	local rifle_offset = CS.Utils.GetFloatFromDictionary(rifle_data, 'ShootOffset', 0.5);

	self.projectile_data = create_generic_dictionary(CS.System.String, CS.System.Object)
	self.projectile_data:Add("Columns", CS.XLua.Cast.Int32(1))
	self.projectile_data:Add("SpreadAngle", CS.XLua.Cast.Int32(0))
	self.projectile_data:Add("Parallel", true)
	self.projectile_data:Add("Projectile", self.machinegun_bullet_name)
	self.projectile_data:Add("ShootOffset", rifle_offset)

	local pattern_info = shoot_helper_util.create_custom_projectile_pattern(self.projectile_data)
	local spec = shoot_helper_util.create_custom_projectile_spec(self.projectile_data)

	self.shoot_helper_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.ShootHelper)
	for i = 2, 3 do
		local ps = CS.Oak.LuaIProjectileShooter(self, self.shyapira_soldier_list[i])
		self.shoot_helper_list:Add(shoot_helper_util.create_shoot_helper_by_spec(CS.Oak.Projectile.MoveType.Directional
		, ps, spec, pattern_info, CS.Oak.ShootHelperShootEffectType.EachShootWithShootOffset))
	end

	-- NPC들이 채굴하는 광석은 못 캐도록 설정
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.InteractableOnOffEvent.Create(self.on_off_interact_event_key, false))
end

-- 프로젝타일 명중 처리
function local_class:on_hit(move_info, hit_info, label)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(hit_info.target, user_party_leader) then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_projectile_preset):Instantiate(user_party_leader.Position)

		if not self.is_hit_player then
			self.is_hit_player = true

			character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'left')
			character_util.spine_deviate_local(user_party_leader, vector(0, 0, 0.3), 0.3, 0.2)
			character_util.spine_pulse_color(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 1)
			character_util.spine_damage_squish(user_party_leader, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)
			character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = "dead", loop = false })
			character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, { name = "damaged" })
		end

		CS.DamageNumber.ShowDamageNumber(hit_info.target, 99999, unity_class.color.red, hit_info.target.Position)
	end
end

-- 샤피라와 병사들, 끌려가는 난민들의 이동
function local_class:move_refugees(dist)
	local speed = 2
	local duration = dist / speed

	character_util.move_to(self.shyapira, self.shyapira.Position + vector(0, 0, dist),
			duration, nil, true, true)

	character_util.move_to(user_party_leader, user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0, dist),
			duration, nil, true, true)

	character_util.move_to(self.passionate_boy, self.passionate_boy.Position + vector(0, 0, dist),
			duration, nil, true, true)

	for i = 0, self.caught_refugee_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.move_to(self.caught_refugee_list[i], self.caught_refugee_list[i].Position + vector(0, 0, dist),
				duration, nil, true, true)
	end

	for i = 0, self.shyapira_soldier_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.move_to(self.shyapira_soldier_list[i], self.shyapira_soldier_list[i].Position + vector(0, 0, dist),
				duration, nil, true, true)
	end

	wait_for_sec(duration)
end

	-- 병사 이동 끝날 때까지 대기 1

-- 제국 병사들이 총 드는 이벤트
function local_class:check_soldiers_moving()
	-- 병사 이동 끝날 때까지 대기
	while self.shyapira_soldier_list[1].CharacterBehaviour.CurrentAction ~= CS.Oak.FieldObjectAction.Stopped do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.move_to(self.shyapira_soldier_list[1], self.shyapira_soldier_list[1].Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0),
			nil, 3, true, true)

	character_util.move_to_async(self.shyapira_soldier_list[0], self.shyapira_soldier_list[0].Position + vector(1.3, 0, 0),
			nil, 3, true, true)

	-- NPC들을 잡아서 기차에 던진다
	for i = 0, self.caught_refugee_list.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_direction(self.caught_refugee_list[i], 'left')

		if i == 1 then
			self.caught_refugee_list[i].Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
			self:set_reset_on_wrong_position(self.caught_refugee_list[i], false)

			character_util.set_anim(self.caught_refugee_list[i], { name = 'embarrassed' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.caught_refugee_list[i], { name = 'damaged' })
		else
			character_util.set_anim(self.caught_refugee_list[i], { name = 'cast' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.caught_refugee_list[i], { name = 'scared' })
		end
	end

	self.passionate_boy.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	self:set_reset_on_wrong_position(self.passionate_boy, false)
	character_util.set_direction(self.passionate_boy, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim(self.passionate_boy, { name = 'embarrassed' })
	character_util.set_emotion(self.passionate_boy, { name = 'damaged' })

	command_util.execute_holdup(self.shyapira_soldier_list[0], self.caught_refugee_list[1], self.shyapira_soldier_list[0].Position)

	command_util.execute_holdup(self.shyapira_soldier_list[1], self.passionate_boy, self.shyapira_soldier_list[1].Position)

	wait_for_sec(1)

	command_util.execute_throw(self.shyapira_soldier_list[0], self.caught_refugee_list[1], vector(1, 0, 0),
			self.shyapira_soldier_list[0].Position, 7, true)

	command_util.execute_throw(self.shyapira_soldier_list[1], self.passionate_boy, vector(1, 0, 0),
			self.shyapira_soldier_list[1].Position, 7, true)

	-- update 실행 순서 문제로 1프레임으로 안정성 보장 안됨. 2프레임 필요.
	coroutine.yield(nil)
	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.passionate_boy.Holdable = CS.Oak.NonHoldable.Instance

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

			nil, 3, true, true)

	self.caught_refugee_list[0].Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()

	character_util.set_emotion(self.caught_refugee_list[0], { name = 'damaged' })

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	character_util.set_direction(self.shyapira_soldier_list[0], 'up')
	character_util.set_anim(self.shyapira_soldier_list[0], { name = 'rifle_idle' })

	self.shyapira_soldier_list[1].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.set_direction(self.shyapira_soldier_list[1], 'down')
	character_util.set_anim(self.shyapira_soldier_list[1], { name = 'rifle_idle' })

	self.train.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	wait_for_sec(1)

	-- 사용했던 NPC 초기화

		self.caught_refugee_list[i].CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
		self:set_reset_on_wrong_position(self.caught_refugee_list[i], true)

	self:set_reset_on_wrong_position(self.passionate_boy, true)
	character_util.set_active_state(self.passionate_boy, 'enabled')
	character_util.set_position(self.passionate_boy, vector(999, 0, 999))

-- ResetOnWrongPosition 접근해서 변경하는 매크로 함수
function local_class:set_reset_on_wrong_position(character, val)
	-- IFieldObjectBehaviour.ResetOnWrongPosition에 접근하지 못해 강제로 캐스팅함
	local bhv = character.CharacterBehaviour
	cast(bhv, typeof(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectBehaviour))
	bhv.ResetOnWrongPosition = val
end

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.butt_bounce_effect_preset)

		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_event')

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

		self.labor_ui = nil

	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ItemGetEvent) then
		self:on_item_get_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then
		self:on_damage_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.ishya_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress == EventProgress.heard_shout then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.fight_with_soldiers

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fight_with_soldiers_event, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.officer) then
		if self.event_progress == EventProgress.complete_crystal then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.heard_shout

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.complete_crystal_event, self))
		else
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.officer, { key = 'steampunk_main_s6_24' })
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_item_get_event(e)
	if e.Item.ItemId == self.crystal_item_id then
		self.crystal_num = self.crystal_num + 1

		if self.event_progress == EventProgress.idle then
			if self.crystal_num >= self.crystal_max then
				self.crystal_num = self.crystal_max

				self.event_progress = EventProgress.complete_crystal

				quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(self.officer)

				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)
				stage.QuestTracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id,
						self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.officer)
				quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_2))
			else
				stage.QuestTracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

				quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:Format(self.quest_tracker_name_1, self.crystal_num))
			end

			self.labor_ui:SetQuota(self.crystal_num, self.crystal_max, 0)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if self.event_progress == EventProgress.fight_with_soldiers then
		for i = 0, self.monster_soldier_list.Count - 1 do
			if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.monster_soldier_list[i]) then
				local require_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick

				if e.Info.type & require_damage_type == require_damage_type then
					local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
					damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
					damage_info.sender = self.monster_soldier_list[i]
					damage_info.target = self.monster_soldier_list[i]
					damage_info.damage = math.floor(self.monster_soldier_list[i].FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.bomb_damage)

					command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
				end
			end
		end

		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.officer) then
			local require_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick

			if e.Info.type & require_damage_type == require_damage_type then
				local damage_info = CS.Oak.DamageInfo()
				damage_info.type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Trap
				damage_info.sender = self.officer
				damage_info.target = self.officer
				damage_info.damage = math.floor(self.officer.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.MaxHP * self.bomb_damage)

				command_util.execute_damage(damage_info)
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		self.event_progress = EventProgress.ending

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.defeat_soldiers_event, self))
	end
end

-- NPC들이 랜덤 방향을 보는 이벤트
function local_class:see_random_dir_event(character_list)
	for n = 0, 3 do
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		for i = 0, character_list.Count - 1 do
			local rand_dir = math.floor(unity_class.random.Range(0, 4))

			if rand_dir == 0 then
				character_util.set_direction(character_list[i], 'up')
			elseif rand_dir == 1 then
				character_util.set_direction(character_list[i], 'down')
			elseif rand_dir == 2 then
				character_util.set_direction(character_list[i], 'right')
			elseif rand_dir == 3 then
				character_util.set_direction(character_list[i], 'left')
			end
		end

		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	end
end

function local_class:reset_npc(character)
	character_util.set_active_state(character, 'enabled')

	character_util.set_position(character, vector(999, 0, 999))
	character_util.remove_anim(character)
	character_util.remove_emotion(character)
end

end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_2 then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.crystal_destroy_effect_preset)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.blockaura_effect_preset)

		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BurnEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_event')
		message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')

		self.sub_event_check_list = { false, false, false, false, false, false, false, false }

		self:setting()

		CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name == self.stage_name_2 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_event, self))

		ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id,
				self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(38.5, 1, 70))
		quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.quest_tracker_name_1))
	end
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		self:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BurnEvent) then
		self:on_burn_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then
		self:on_damage_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		self:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		self:on_touch_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	if self.talk_with_ishya then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.frontyard_event_zone_name_1 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.soldier_salute_event, self, 1))
	elseif zone_name == self.frontyard_event_zone_name_2 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.soldier_salute_event, self, 2))
	elseif zone_name == self.frontyard_event_zone_name_3 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.soldier_salute_event, self, 3))
	elseif zone_name == self.frontyard_event_zone_name_4 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.soldier_salute_event, self, 4))
	elseif zone_name == self.enter_labor_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress < EventProgress.enter_labor then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.enter_labor

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.enter_labor_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.battle_event_zone_name then
		if not self.see_battle_talk then
			self.see_battle_talk = true

			local battle_monster = get_character(self.battle_soldier_name)

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(battle_monster, { key = 'steampunk_main_s8_20' })
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.old_man_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress == EventProgress.old_man_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.old_man_event_finished

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.old_man_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.penny_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress == EventProgress.penny_event then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.penny_event_finished

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.penny_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.end_event_zone_name then
		if self.event_progress == EventProgress.penny_event_finished then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.ending

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ending, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.cold_event_zone_name then
		if not self.sub_event_check_list[EventIndex.cold] and not self.is_cold_event then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.cold_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.rest_event_zone_name then
		if not self.sub_event_check_list[EventIndex.bad_singer] and not self.is_rest_event then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.rest_event, self))
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.blocked_rock_zone_name then
		if not self.is_enter_block_rock_zone then
			self.is_enter_block_rock_zone = true

			self.train_interactable = self.train.Interactable
			self.train.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.eat_soldiers_zone_name then
		if self.eat_sfx == nil then
			self.eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_eat_01', parent = self.eat_soldier_list[0], loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'player'})
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.residence_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

		if self.event_progress == EventProgress.talk_with_ishya then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest,
					vector(5.5, 0, 101))
		elseif self.event_progress == EventProgress.idle then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(
					self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id, self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.ishya)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	if not e.FullLeave then return end
	if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return end
	if self.talk_with_ishya then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.eat_soldiers_zone_name then
		if self.eat_sfx ~= nil then
			self.eat_sfx:FadeOut()
			self.eat_sfx = nil
		end
	elseif zone_name == self.residence_zone_name then
		ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.quest_marker_name)

		if self.event_progress == EventProgress.idle then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(38.5, 1, 70))
		elseif self.event_progress == EventProgress.talk_with_ishya  then
			ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToPoint(self.quest_marker_name, self.quest_id,
					self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, vector(-19.5, 0, 55.5))
		end
	end
end

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.ishya) then
		if self.event_progress == EventProgress.idle then
			self.event_progress = EventProgress.talk_with_ishya

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_ishya_event, self))

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.lost_pickaxe_clear_event, self))

		else
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.lost_pickaxe_refugee, { key = 'steampunk_main_s8_lost_pickaxe_3' })
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.pickaxe_crystal) then
		if not self.get_pickaxe then
			self.get_pickaxe = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.get_pickaxe_event, self))

--region Dont Know Labor Refugee
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.dont_know_labor_refugee) then
		if not self.sub_event_check_list[EventIndex.dont_know_labor] then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.dont_know_labor_event, self))
		end
	end

--region Hard Crystal
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.hard_crystal_refugee) then
		if not self.sub_event_check_list[EventIndex.hard_crystal] then
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.hard_crystal_refugee, { key = 'steampunk_main_s8_hard_crystal_0' })
		else
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.hard_crystal_refugee, { key = 'steampunk_main_s8_hard_crystal_2' })
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.hard_crystal) then
		if not self.sub_event_check_list[EventIndex.hard_crystal] then
			self.sub_event_check_list[EventIndex.hard_crystal] = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.mine_hard_crystal_event, self))

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.tunnel_refugee) then

			self.sub_event_check_list[EventIndex.tunnel] = true

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.tunnel_refugee, { key = 'steampunk_main_s8_tunnel_6' })

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.campfire) then
		if not self.sub_event_check_list[EventIndex.cold] then
			self.sub_event_check_list[EventIndex.cold] = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.cold_event_complete, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.beat_soldier) then
		if not self.sub_event_check_list[EventIndex.stop_fight] then
			self.stop_beat_refugee = true
			self.sub_event_check_list[EventIndex.stop_fight] = true

			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(
					self.beat_soldier.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0))
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(
					self.beat_soldier.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0))

			self.beat_soldier.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
			character_util.air_spin(self.beat_soldier, { offset = vector(-1, 0, 0), speed = 1.5, stay_time = 0.5 })

			character_util.look_at(self.beaten_refugee, user_party_leader)
			character_util.set_anim(self.beaten_refugee, { name = 'sing' })
			character_util.set_emotion(self.beaten_refugee, { name = 'tired' })
			self.beaten_refugee.Interactable.Talk = 'steampunk_main_s8_stop_fight_2'

			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.beaten_refugee, { key = 'steampunk_main_s8_stop_fight_2' })
		end
	elseif lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, self.bad_singer_soldier) then
		local require_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick

		if e.Info.type & require_damage_type == require_damage_type then
			if not self.sub_event_check_list[EventIndex.bad_singer] then
				self.sub_event_check_list[EventIndex.bad_singer] = true

				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
						stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.damaged_bad_singer, self))
			end
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	for i = 0, self.blocked_rock_list.Count - 1 do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, self.blocked_rock_list[i]) and
				not self.sub_event_check_list[EventIndex.block_rock] then
			self.sub_event_check_list[EventIndex.block_rock] = true

			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.destroy_blocked_rock_event, self))

			break
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.is_hard_crystal_event and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown and
			self.time_since_last_tap_count > 0.3 then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.attack_hard_rock, self))

	elseif self.is_get_pickaxe_event and e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
		self.qte_complete = true
	end
end

-- 섹션 입장 시 NPC 설정
function local_class:setting()
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress == 7 then
		-- 남녀 확인 후 파티 리더 변경
		local select_male = user:GetCharacter(CS.Oak.CharacterSpecId.KnightFemale, true) == nil
		local manual_character_name

		if select_male then
			manual_character_name = self.knight_male_refugee_name
		else
			manual_character_name = self.knight_female_refugee_name
		end

		self.controller:change_manual_character(manual_character_name)
	end

	local start_marker = field:GetMarker(self.start_marker_name)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_position(user_party[i], start_marker.position + vector(0, 0, -0.5) -
				CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.ToVector3(start_marker.direction) * CS.Oak.Constants.DistBetweenPartyMembers * i)
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], start_marker.direction)
	end

	self.ishya = get_character(self.ishya_name)
	character_util.set_position(self.ishya, vector(5.5, 0, 113))
	character_util.set_direction(self.ishya, 'down')
	self.ishya.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	self.shyapira = get_character(self.shyapira_name)
	character_util.set_position(self.shyapira, vector(4, 0, 112))
	character_util.set_direction(self.shyapira, 'right')

	self.train = get_character(self.train_name)

	-- 병사 배치
	self.soldier_list = create_generic_list(CS.Oak.Character)

	for i = 1, self.soldier_num do
		self.soldier_list:Add(get_character(self.soldier_name..i))
	end

	local soldier_pos_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)
	soldier_pos_list:Add(vector(-24, 0, 57))

-- 이 섹션에서 게임 시작 시 실행되는 이벤트
function local_class:start_event()
	music_player_util.set_stage_music_clip_async({ name = 'bgm_steampunk_basement', state = 'field' })

	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ name = 'bgm_steampunk_main', state = 'event', mix = 2 })

	local start_marker = field:GetMarker(self.start_marker_name)

	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress ~= 7 then
		screen_util.fade_out_async(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		screen_util.fade_out_circular_async(0, 'linear')
		camera_util.return_to_leader(0)

		screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		screen_util.fade_in_circular_async(0.5, 'linear')
	else
		screen_util.fade_in(0, unity_class.color.black, 'linear')
		screen_util.fade_in_circular(0.5, 'linear')

		wait_for_sec(0.2)
	end

	-- 스테이지 타이틀 표시
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowStageTitle(game_string:GetString(self.next_day_string))

	quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(self.ishya)

	-- 곡괭이 위치 재설정
	self.lost_pickaxe:SetPosition(vector(-13.7, 1, 70.5), true)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.StageControlStartEvent.Instance)
end

-- 관사 밖 군인들이 경례하는 이벤트
function local_class:soldier_salute_event(index)
	if self.event_progress > EventProgress.idle then
		if not self.is_salute_list[index] then
			self.is_salute_list[index] = true

			for i = 0, 1 do
				character_util.set_anim(self.frontyard_soldier_list[2 * (index - 1) + i], { name = 'salute', loop = false, sfx_name = '02_twohand_stomp_jump_01' })
			end
		end
	end
end

-- 관사 밖 군인들이 경례 끝내는 이벤트
function local_class:soldier_salute_end_event(index)
	if self.event_progress > EventProgress.idle then
		for i = 0, 1 do
			character_util.remove_anim(self.frontyard_soldier_list[2 * (index - 1) + i])
		end
	end
end

	wait_for_sec(0.4)

	self.pickaxe_crystal:Shake(0.04, 1)

	for n = 0, 1 do
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.pickaxe_crystal.Position)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.pickaxe_crystal.Position)

		wait_for_sec(0.75)
	end

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_rock_break_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.crystal_destroy_effect_preset):Instantiate(self.pickaxe_crystal.Position)

	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_crystal_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	self.pickaxe_crystal.ActiveState = CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled

	camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.3)

	user_party.Leader.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'empty')
	user_party.Leader:HideWeapon(false)
	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)

	local rand_pos = vector(CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-0.5, 0.5), 0, CS.UnityEngine.Random.Range(-0.5, 0.5))

	drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = self.pickaxe_crystal.Position, target = user_party_leader.Position + rand_pos,
	                             itemid = self.crystal_item_id, notforinven = true })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local duration = 0.5

	local start_pos = self.lost_pickaxe.Position
	local end_pos = user_party_leader.Position

	local freefall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(12, 54, start_pos.y, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < duration do
		local cur_x = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_pos.x, end_pos.x - start_pos.x, duration)
		local cur_z = CS.Oak.Interpolations.EaseOutSine(
				unity_class.time.time - cur_time, start_pos.z, end_pos.z - start_pos.z, duration)

		freefall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local dist_y = freefall:GetDistance()

		self.lost_pickaxe:SetPosition(vector(cur_x, dist_y, cur_z), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	self.lost_pickaxe:SetPosition(vector(end_pos.x, 0, end_pos.z), true)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.lost_pickaxe.ConsumeTarget = user_party_leader
	self.lost_pickaxe:Fly()

	quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(self.lost_pickaxe_refugee)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

-- 난민 회전 이벤트
function local_class:rotate_refugee_event()
	local timer = 0
	local count = 3
	local direction_val = 0

	while self.is_rotate do
		timer = timer + 1

		if timer >= count then
			timer = 0

			if direction_val == 0 then
				direction_val = 1

				character_util.set_direction(self.dont_know_labor_refugee, 'down')
			elseif direction_val == 1 then
				direction_val = 2

				character_util.set_direction(self.dont_know_labor_refugee, 'right')
			elseif direction_val == 2 then
				direction_val = 3

				character_util.set_direction(self.dont_know_labor_refugee, 'up')
			elseif direction_val == 3 then
				direction_val = 0

				character_util.set_direction(self.dont_know_labor_refugee, 'left')
			end
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	character_util.set_direction(self.dont_know_labor_refugee, 'up')
end

-- 제국 병사가 난민을 구타하는 이벤트
function local_class:beat_refugee_event()
	local timer = 0
	local is_beat = false
	local hit_duraton = 0.3
	local is_hit = false
	local reset_duration = 1

	while not self.stop_beat_refugee do
		if self.is_exit then
			break
		end

		timer = timer + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if not is_beat then
			is_beat = true

			character_util.spine_deviate_local(self.beat_soldier, vector(0.5, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
			character_util.set_anim(self.beat_soldier, { name = 'attack', loop = false })
		elseif not is_hit and timer >= hit_duraton then
			is_hit = true

			music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_npc_01', parent = self.beaten_refugee, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(
					self.beaten_refugee.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
			unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(
					self.beaten_refugee.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

			character_util.remove_anim(self.beat_soldier)

			character_util.spine_deviate_local(self.beaten_refugee, vector(0.3, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
		elseif timer >= reset_duration then
			timer = 0
			is_beat = false
			is_hit = false
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if self.is_exit == false then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.check_happy_point, self, self.normal_event_happy_point, true))
	end
end

	self.blocked_rock_refugee.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.refugee_walk_to_crystal, self))

	self.train.Interactable = self.train_interactable

end

-- 바위가 파괴되고 난민이 일터로 걸어가는 이벤트
function local_class:refugee_walk_to_crystal()
	self.blocked_rock_refugee.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance

	-- 부서진 바위를 확인해서 이동 거리 결정
	local waypoint_list = create_generic_list(unity_class.vector3)

	if self.blocked_rock_list[0].ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
		waypoint_list:Add(self.blocked_rock_refugee.Position + vector(-4, 0, 0))
	elseif self.blocked_rock_list[1].ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
		waypoint_list:Add(self.blocked_rock_refugee.Position + vector(0, 0, 1))
		waypoint_list:Add(self.blocked_rock_refugee.Position + vector(-4, 0, 1))
	elseif self.blocked_rock_list[2].ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
		waypoint_list:Add(self.blocked_rock_refugee.Position + vector(2, 0, 0))
		waypoint_list:Add(self.blocked_rock_refugee.Position + vector(2, 0, 3))
		waypoint_list:Add(self.blocked_rock_refugee.Position + vector(-4, 0, 3))
	elseif self.blocked_rock_list[3].ActiveState == CS.Oak.ActiveState.Disabled then
		waypoint_list:Add(self.blocked_rock_refugee.Position + vector(4, 0, 0))
		waypoint_list:Add(self.blocked_rock_refugee.Position + vector(4, 0, 3))
		waypoint_list:Add(self.blocked_rock_refugee.Position + vector(-4, 0, 3))
	end

	waypoint_list:Add(self.blocked_rock_refugee.Position + vector(-4, 0, 4))

	character_util.set_anim(self.blocked_rock_refugee, { name = 'walk' })
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.blocked_rock_refugee, waypoint_list, 4, false, 'stop',
			'floor', 'up')

	self.blocked_rock_refugee.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self.blocked_rock_refugee.SpineController:SetAttachment('[base]weapon1', 'pickaxe_bronze_sword')
	character_util.set_anim(self.blocked_rock_refugee, { name = 'twohand_attack2' })

	while self.event_progress < EventProgress.ending do
		wait_for_sec(0.35)

		self.blocked_rock_refugee_crystal:Shake(0.04, 0.5)

		wait_for_sec(0.4)
	end
end

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if self.is_rest_event then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_coop_mvp_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.bad_singer_soldier,
				{
					key = 'steampunk_main_s8_bad_singer_2',
					bubble_type = 'shout',
					screen_pos = vector(-100, -100),
					skip = true
				})
	end

	if self.is_rest_event then
		music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_dialogue_tipsy_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.rest_refugee_list[0], { key = 'steampunk_main_s8_bad_singer_0' })

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.cold_refugee_list[1], { key = 'steampunk_main_s8_bad_singer_1' })
	end

	self.is_rest_event = false
end

-- 점수 증가 처리
function local_class:check_happy_point(val, stop)
	local stop_event = lua_helper.get_or_default(stop, false)

	-- 이벤트 조건을 만족하면 특수 이벤트 발생
	-- 페니 이벤트는 노인 이벤트를 본 뒤에만 나오도록 설정
	if self.event_progress >= EventProgress.old_man_event_finished and self.event_progress < EventProgress.penny_event
			and self.happy_point + val >= self.happy_point_check_2 then
		coroutine.yield(self:show_happy_point(val))

		field_ui_manager:Hide()

		if stop_event then
			user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
		end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.penny_intro_event, self))
	elseif self.event_progress < EventProgress.old_man_event and self.happy_point + val >= self.happy_point_check_1 then
		coroutine.yield(self:show_happy_point(val))

		field_ui_manager:Hide()

		if stop_event then
			user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
		end

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.old_man_intro_event, self))
	else
		user_party:ResetControllers()

		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
				stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.show_happy_point, self, val))
	end
end

-- 점수 증가 연출
function local_class:show_happy_point(val)
	-- UI 보여줘야 되서 켠다
	field_ui_manager:Show()

	local increase_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_count_number_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local up_time = 1

	local start_point = self.happy_point
	local end_point = self.happy_point + val

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < up_time do
		local normalized = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / up_time
		local cur_point = math.floor(start_point + (end_point - start_point) * normalized)

		self.labor_ui:SetQuota(cur_point, self.happy_point_max, 0)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	increase_sfx:FadeOut()

	self.happy_point = self.happy_point + val

	self.labor_ui:SetQuota(self.happy_point, self.happy_point_max, 0)
end

-- 캐릭터가 다른 캐릭터를 발로 걷어차는 연출
function local_class:kick_victim(kicker, victim)
	local dir = (victim.Position - kicker.Position).normalized

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(kicker, dir * 0.5, 0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.set_anim(kicker, { name = 'gauntlet_kick', loop = false })

	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_hit_dummy_02', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })

	character_util.remove_anim(kicker)

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(victim.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.impact_hit_effect_preset):Instantiate(victim.Position + vector(0, 0.3, 0))

	character_util.spine_deviate_local(victim, dir * 0.3, 0.3, 0.2)
	character_util.spine_pulse_color(victim, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 1, 0.5)
	character_util.spine_damage_squish(victim, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.5)

	wait_for_sec(0.7)
end

local local_class = newclass('SteampunkNobleDaughterSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = SteampunkNobleDaughter @
		Comment = 귀족 딸과 첫 대화 @
		Index = 0 @
		NextSections = 1 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- npc 이름
	self.noble_daughter_name = 'noble_daughter'
	self.old_man_name = 'noble_daughter_old_man'

	-- 마커 이름
	self.setting_marker_name = 'noble_daughter_pos_'
	self.run_marker_name = 'noble_daughter_run_pos'

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.run_daughter_zone_name = 'run_noble_daughter_zone_1'

	self.progress_enum = {
		none = 1,
		-- 귀족 딸이랑 대화 및 돕게 됨
		help_daughter = 2,
		-- 왼쪽 방으로 달려가는 귀족 딸
		run_daughter = 3
	}

	self.current_progress = nil

	self.talk_skip = false
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')

	local noble_daughter = get_character(self.noble_daughter_name)
	local old_man = get_character(self.old_man_name)

	local marker = field:GetMarker(self.setting_marker_name .. 1).position
	noble_daughter.Position = marker
	old_man.Position = marker + unity_class.vector3.right

	character_util.add_listener(noble_daughter, self.controller)
	character_util.add_listener(old_man, self.controller)

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.none

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	local noble_daughter = get_character(self.noble_daughter_name)
	local old_man = get_character(self.old_man_name)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(noble_daughter, self.controller)
	character_util.remove_relate_event(old_man, self.controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.progress_enum = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local target = {
		get_character(self.noble_daughter_name),
		get_character(self.old_man_name)
	}

	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, target) and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none then
		self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.help_daughter, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party_leader, self.run_daughter_zone_name) then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.help_daughter then
			self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.run_noble_daughter, self)
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

local local_class = newclass('SteampunkNobleDaughterSection2')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = SteampunkNobleDaughter @
		Comment = 귀족 딸의 장난감 찾기 @
		Index = 1 @
		NextSections = 2 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- npc 이름
	self.noble_daughter_name = 'noble_daughter'

	-- 기믹 이름
	self.toy_name = 'noble_daughter_toy'

	-- 마커 이름
	self.setting_marker_name = 'noble_daughter_pos_'
	self.run_marker_name = 'noble_daughter_run_pos'

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.run_daughter_zone_name = 'run_noble_daughter_zone_2'

	-- 이펙트 이름
	self.twinkle_effect_name = 'FX_Object_Twinkle'

	self.gem_toy_id = 20191

	self.progress_enum = {
		none = 1,
		-- 귀족 딸이랑 대화 및 돕게 됨
		help_daughter = 2,
		-- 숨겨둔 장난감을 찾음
		find_toy = 3,
		-- 찾은 장난감을 줌
		give_toy = 4,
		-- 아래쪽 방으로 달려가는 귀족 딸
		run_daughter = 5,
		-- 귀족 딸이랑 대화
		talk_daughter = 6
	}

	self.current_progress = nil

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadItemGetEvent()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_interact_event')

	local noble_daughter = get_character(self.noble_daughter_name)

	noble_daughter.Position = field:GetMarker(self.setting_marker_name .. 2).position
	character_util.set_direction(noble_daughter, 'right')

	character_util.add_listener(noble_daughter, self.controller)

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.none

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.twinkle_effect_name)

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	local noble_daughter = get_character(self.noble_daughter_name)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(noble_daughter, self.controller)

	if self.twinkle_effect ~= nil then
		self.twinkle_effect:Dispose()
	end

	self.twinkle_effect = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.progress_enum = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, get_character(self.noble_daughter_name)) then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.none then
			self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.help_daughter, self)
		end

		if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.find_toy then
			self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.give_toy, self)
		end

		if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.run_daughter then
			self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_daughter, self)
		end

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if type_util.is_zone_full_enter(e, user_party_leader, self.run_daughter_zone_name) then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.give_toy then
			self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.run_noble_daughter, self)
		end
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if type_util.is_interacted_target(e, get_field_object(self.toy_name)) then
		if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.help_daughter then
			self.current_progress = self.current_progress + 1
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.find_toy, self)
		end
		return true
	end
	return false
end

-- 귀족 딸을 돕게 됨
function local_class:help_daughter()
	local noble_daughter = get_character(self.noble_daughter_name)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(noble_daughter, self.controller)

	party_util.align_to_target(noble_daughter, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	character_util.set_emotion(noble_daughter, { name = 'smile' })
	character_util.set_anim(noble_daughter, { name = 'victory_get', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01' })
	-- 친구 집에 가는데 빈 손으로 가는 건 예의가 아니라 배웠어요!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(noble_daughter,
		{ key = 'steampunk_2_noble_daughter_14', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(noble_daughter)

	character_util.set_anim(noble_daughter, { name = 'release', sfx_name = '01_swing_01' })
	-- 저번에 제가 갖고온 장난감을 여기 숨겨뒀거든요.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(noble_daughter,
		{ key = 'steampunk_2_noble_daughter_15', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(noble_daughter)

	-- 같이 찾아주시곘어요?
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(noble_daughter,
		{ key = 'steampunk_2_noble_daughter_16', skip = true })

	local toy = get_field_object(self.toy_name)
	toy.Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()

	-- 반짝이 이펙트 생성
	self.twinkle_effect = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.twinkle_effect_name):Instantiate(toy.Position)
end

-- 장난감을 찾음
function local_class:find_toy()
	local gem_toy = get_field_object(self.toy_name)
	gem_toy.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	local target_pos = gem_toy.Position + 0.3 * unity_class.vector3.left
	party_util.align_party(target_pos, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	local eat_sound = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '03_equipping_01' })
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, { name = 'eat' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	eat_sound:Stop()

	character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)

	self.twinkle_effect:Dispose()

	-- 아이템 획득 연출
	local item_place_holder = CS.Oak.ItemPlaceholder()
	item_place_holder.ItemId = self.gem_toy_id
	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ItemGetEvent, item_place_holder,
		'noble_daughter_gem_toy_subtitle', 'noble_daughter_gem_toy_desc')

	character_util.add_listener(get_character(self.noble_daughter_name), self.controller)
end

-- 장난감을 줌
function local_class:give_toy()
	local noble_daughter = get_character(self.noble_daughter_name)

	character_util.remove_relate_event(noble_daughter, self.controller)

	party_util.align_to_target(noble_daughter, 'right', 1, 'linear')

	character_util.set_animation_n_times(user_party_leader, { name = 'release' })
	-- 장난감 넘겨줌
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	local target_pos = noble_daughter.Position + 0.4 * unity_class.vector3.right
	local gem_toy = drop_item_util.create_item({ pos = user_party_leader.Position, target = target_pos,
												 itemid = self.gem_toy_id, notforinven = true,
												 lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.75 })

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_anim(noble_daughter, { name= 'eat' })
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.remove_anim(noble_daughter)

	gem_toy.ConsumeTarget = noble_daughter

	character_util.set_emotion(noble_daughter, { name = 'greed' })
	character_util.set_anim(noble_daughter, { name = 'success', sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01' })
	-- 반짝반짝 예쁜게. 세라도 좋아하겠죠?

		{ key = 'steampunk_2_noble_daughter_17', skip = true })

	character_util.set_emotion(noble_daughter, { name = 'burning' })
	-- 저도 아빠한테 하나 만들어 달라 해야겠어요!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(noble_daughter,
		{ key = 'steampunk_2_noble_daughter_19', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(noble_daughter)

	local waypoints = {
		noble_daughter.Position + vector(0, 0, -1),

	wp_util.move_way_points_async(noble_daughter,

	noble_daughter.Position = field:GetMarker(self.run_marker_name).position
	character_util.set_direction(noble_daughter, 'down')
end

-- 아래쪽 방으로 달려가는 귀족 소녀

	local noble_daughter = get_character(self.noble_daughter_name)

		{ waypoints = noble_daughter.Position + 10 * unity_class.vector3.back,

	character_util.set_direction(noble_daughter, 'right')

	local noble_daughter = get_character(self.noble_daughter_name)

local local_class = newclass('SteampunkPrincessSection1')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller

	self.get_princess = function()
		return get_character('little_princess')
	end

	self.is_event_done = false

	self.star_piece_name = 'princess_star_piece'
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	local princess = self.get_princess()

	if princess.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		princess.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
	end

	character_util.set_anim(princess, {name = 'seat', loop = true})
	character_util.set_anim(princess, {name = 'cast', loop = true, upper = true})
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'tired'})
end

function local_class:start()

end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	local princess = self.get_princess()
	if type_util.is_npc_interactable(princess) then
		princess.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.cs_controller = nil
	self.get_dozing_guard = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_princess()) and not self.is_event_done then
		self.is_event_done = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_princess, self)
	end
end

function local_class:talk_with_princess()
	local princess = self.get_princess()

	party_util.align_party(princess, 'left', 1, 'arc')

	--(tired, seat, right) 부디 이 영혼을 어루만져 주시어…
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'steampunk_princess_1', skip = true})

	character_util.remove_anim(princess, true)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)

	--(idle, idle, left) 아, 안녕 {0}!
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'left')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess,
			{key = game_string:Format('steampunk_princess_2', user.Name),  override_key = 'steampunk_princess_2', skip = true})

	--(idle, idle) 죽은 사람들을 위해 기도해주고 있었어.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'steampunk_princess_3', skip = true})

	--(idle, idle) 예전에 아버지가 돌아가셨을 때 다들 이렇게 했대.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'steampunk_princess_4', skip = true})

	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')

	--(tired)...
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'tired'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'steampunk_princess_5', skip = true})

	--(cast)아빠 보고싶다...
	character_util.set_anim(princess, {name = 'cast', loop = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'steampunk_princess_6', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_swing_01')
	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'left')

	--(attack, release)아냐, 이제 그런 걸로 울진 않을거야
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'steampunk_princess_7', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)

	--(smile, victory_get) 맞다! {0} 보면 주려고 이거 챙겨놨어!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_small_jump_01')
	character_util.set_anim(princess, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false})
	character_util.set_emotion(princess, {name = 'idle'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess,
			{key = 'steampunk_princess_8', skip = true})
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(princess)

	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'right')
	local equip_sfx = 	music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '03_equipping_01',
													 type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})
	character_util.set_anim(princess, {name = 'eat', loop = true})

	wait_for_sec(1)

	equip_sfx:FadeOut(0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim(princess)

	character_util.set_direction(princess, 'left')

	--스타피스 드랍
	local star_piece = get_field_object(self.star_piece_name)
	star_piece:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(princess.Position + vector(0, 0.7, 0)))

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(princess, {key = 'steampunk_princess_9', skip = true})

	if type_util.is_npc_interactable(princess) then
		princess.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
		princess.Interactable.Talk = 'steampunk_princess_9'
	end

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('SteampunkScrapMetalDoguSection1')

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	-- 토우가 고철상 주변 존 안에 있는지
	self.dogu_in_merchant_zone = false
	-- 플레이어가 고철상 주변 존 안에 있는지
	self.player_near_merchant = false
	-- 플레이어가 해당 존에서 이벤트를 실행중인지
	self.player_in_zone = false
	-- 고철상과 대화 했는지
	self.merchant_first_talk = false

	self.merchant_name = 'scrap_metal_merchant'
	self.dogu_name = 'scrap_metal_dogu'
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_stage_loaded_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')

	local dogu = get_character(self.dogu_name)
	dogu.Position = field:GetMarker('dogu_pos').position
	dogu.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)

	local merchant = get_character(self.merchant_name)
	local marker = field:GetMarker('scrap_metal_pos').position
	merchant.Position = marker
	merchant.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)

	local star_piece_wall = get_field_object('star_piece_wall')
	star_piece_wall.Position = marker + 1.5 * unity_class.vector3.right

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))

	local dogu = get_character(self.dogu_name)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(dogu.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		dogu.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end

	local merchant = get_character(self.merchant_name)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(merchant.Interactable, CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		merchant.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		local dogu = get_character(self.dogu_name)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, dogu) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.pull_out_dogu, self)
			return true
		end

		local merchant = get_character(self.merchant_name)
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, merchant) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.merchant_talk, self)
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event(e)

	-- 토우 초기 세팅
	local dogu = get_character(self.dogu_name)
	dogu.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(0, -0.8, 0)
	dogu.OverrideCrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.PortableCrashBehaviour()
	dogu.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
	character_util.spine_rotate(dogu, 45, 0)
	character_util.set_anim(dogu, { name = 'idle', loop = false })
	field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(dogu, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)

	return true
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter or self.player_in_zone then return false end

	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == 'near_dogu_star_piece' and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		self.player_in_zone = true
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.player_near_star_piece, self)
		return true
	end

	local dogu = get_character(self.dogu_name)

	-- 토우를 주는 이벤트 실행 (플레이어가 토우를 들고있는지 안 들고있는지에 따라 다른 처리)
	local give_dogu_event = function()
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(dogu.Holdable.Holder, user_party_leader) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.give_dogu, self, true)
		elseif self.dogu_in_merchant_zone then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.give_dogu, self, false)
		end
	end

	if zone_name == 'near_merchant' and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, dogu) then
		self.dogu_in_merchant_zone = true

		if self.player_near_merchant then
			give_dogu_event()
		end

		return true
	end

	if zone_name == 'near_merchant' and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		self.player_near_merchant = true

		give_dogu_event()

		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	local dogu = get_character(self.dogu_name)
	if zone_name == 'near_merchant' and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, dogu) then
		self.dogu_in_merchant_zone = false
		return true
	end

	if zone_name == 'near_merchant' and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		self.player_near_merchant = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 스타피스 근처에 갔을 때 이벤트
function local_class:player_near_star_piece()
	local merchant = get_character(self.merchant_name)
	character_util.look_at(merchant, user_party_leader)

	-- 이 빛나는 돌은 지금 나한테 가장 소중한 거야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, { key = '이 빛나는 돌은 지금 나한테 가장 소중한 거야.', skip = true })

	-- 내 마음에 들만한 물건을 가져오면 이 빛나는 돌을 줄게.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant, { key = '내 마음에 들만한 물건을 가져오면 이 빛나는 돌을 줄게.', skip = true })

	local star_piece = get_field_object('dogu_star_piece')
	local leader_dir = vector_util.to_direction(user_party_leader.Position - star_piece.Position)
	if leader_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Right then
		if merchant.Position.z < user_party_leader.Position.z then
			leader_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
		else
			leader_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		end
	end
	party_util.align_party(user_party_leader.Position, leader_dir, 0.5, 'linear')

	character_util.set_direction(merchant, 'left')

	self.player_in_zone = false
end

-- 고철상과 대화
function local_class:merchant_talk()
	local merchant = get_character(self.merchant_name)
	merchant.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)

	party_util.align_to_target(merchant, 'left', 1, 'linear')

	if not self.merchant_first_talk then
		character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(user_party_leader,
			{ name = 'release', count = 2, sfx = '01_swing_01' })

		character_util.remove_anim(user_party_leader)

		-- 뭐? 이 빛나는 돌을 달라고?
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant,
			{ key = 'steampunk_4_scrap_metal_dogu_1', skip = true })
	end

	self.merchant_first_talk = true

	-- 이 빛나는 돌은 지금 나한테 가장 소중한 거야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant,
		{ key = 'steampunk_4_scrap_metal_dogu_2', skip = true })

	-- 내 마음에 들만한 물건을 가져오면 이 빛나는 돌을 줄게.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant,
		{ key = 'steampunk_4_scrap_metal_dogu_3', skip = true })

	merchant.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)
end

-- 토우 뽑는 이벤트
function local_class:pull_out_dogu()
	local dogu = get_character(self.dogu_name)
	dogu.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)

	local look_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	party_util.align_party(dogu.Position - 0.4 * direction_util.to_vector3(look_dir), look_dir,
		1, 'linear')

	party_util.set_emotion({ name = 'burning' })
	party_util.set_anim({ name = 'push', upper = true })
	character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], { name = 'walk', scale = 0.2 })

	-- Tap 이벤트
	local tap_count = 8
	local cur_tap_count = 0

	local touch_handler = {
		callback = function(_, e)
			if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Tap then
				cur_tap_count = cur_tap_count + 1

				local offset_x = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(0, -0.4, cur_tap_count / tap_count)
				local offset_y = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(-0.8, 0, cur_tap_count / tap_count)
				dogu.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(offset_x, offset_y, 0)

				music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_clang_01')

				for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
					local end_pos = user_party[i].Position + 0.15 * unity_class.vector3.left
					user_party[i].Position =
						unity_class.vector3.Lerp(user_party[i].Position, end_pos, cur_tap_count / tap_count)
					user_party[i].SpineController:DeviateLocal(vector(-0.1, 0, 0), 0.2, 0.2)
				end
			end

			return true
		end
	}

	message_system:Subscribe(touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'callback')

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1)

	while cur_tap_count < tap_count do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(touch_handler, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	dogu.SpineController.SpineOffset = vector(0, 0, 0)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.remove_anim(user_party[i], true)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party[i])
	end

	-- 뽑히는 토우
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_treasure_item_popup_01')

	local flying_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Left
	local duration = 0.5
	character_util.spine_rotate(dogu, 360, duration)
	character_util.jump(dogu, 3, duration)
	character_util.move_to_async(dogu, dogu.Position + 5.5 * direction_util.to_vector3(flying_dir), duration)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_bounce_iron_01')

	dogu.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()
	dogu.Holdable.BounceSfxHandleName = '01_bounce_iron_02'
end

-- 토우를 줌
function local_class:give_dogu(held_up)
	local dogu = get_character(self.dogu_name)
	local merchant = get_character(self.merchant_name)

	self.player_in_zone = true

	local look_dir = vector_util.to_direction(merchant.Position - user_party_leader.Position)
	if look_dir == CS.Oak.Direction.Left then
		if merchant.Position.z < user_party_leader.Position.z then
			look_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Down
		else
			look_dir = CS.Oak.Direction.Up
		end
	end

	user_party:PositionParty(user_party_leader.Position, look_dir, 0.5, 'linear')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.look_at(merchant, user_party_leader)

	-- 토우를 들고 있다면
	if held_up then
		command_util.execute_throw(user_party_leader, dogu, direction_util.to_vector3(user_party_leader.Direction),
			user_party_leader.Position, 6, false)
		wait_for_sec(1)
	end

	-- 토우를 살펴보는 고철상
	local merchant_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(merchant.Position - dogu.Position)
	character_util.move_to_async(merchant, dogu.Position + direction_util.to_vector3(merchant_dir),
		nil, 4, true, true)

	character_util.look_at(merchant, dogu)
	-- 이 오래된 쓰레기는 뭐야.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant,
		{ key = 'steampunk_4_scrap_metal_dogu_4', skip = true })

	local eat_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_clang_01' })
	character_util.set_anim(merchant, { name = 'eat' })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	eat_sfx:Stop()

	-- 이... 이건!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant,
		{ key = 'steampunk_4_scrap_metal_dogu_5', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(merchant)

	character_util.set_emotion(merchant, { name = 'surprise' })
	character_util.normal_jump_async(merchant, '01_player_jump_01')

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_negative_02')
	-- 200년전 고대 가디언들이 사용했던 고대 유물이잖아!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant,
		{ key = 'steampunk_4_scrap_metal_dogu_6', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_emotion(merchant)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_rustle_01')
	character_util.set_anim(merchant, { name = 'question', loop = false })
	-- 대충 팔아도 200백만 골드는 되겠어.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant,
		{ key = 'steampunk_4_scrap_metal_dogu_7', skip = true })

	character_util.remove_anim(merchant)

	-- 스타피스 앞에서 고민하는 고철상
	local star_piece_wall = get_field_object('star_piece_wall')
	merchant_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(merchant.Position - star_piece_wall.Position)
	character_util.move_to_async(merchant, star_piece_wall.Position + direction_util.to_vector3(merchant_dir),
		nil, 4, true, true)

	character_util.look_at(merchant, star_piece_wall)
	character_util.set_anim(merchant, { name = 'cross_arm' })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	character_util.remove_anim(merchant)

	character_util.look_at(merchant, user_party_leader)
	-- 좋아. 저 빛나는 돌을 가져가도 좋아.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(merchant,
		{ key = 'steampunk_4_scrap_metal_dogu_8', skip = true })

	-- 토우를 들고 나가는 고철상
	merchant_dir = vector_util.to_side_dir(merchant.Position - dogu.Position)
	character_util.move_to_async(merchant, dogu.Position + 0.5 * unity_class.vector3.left,
		nil, 4, true, true)

	character_util.look_at(merchant, dogu)
	command_util.execute_holdup(merchant, dogu, merchant.Position)
	wait_for_sec(0.3)

	character_util.move_to_async(merchant, merchant.Position + 9 * unity_class.vector3.forward,
		nil, 4, true, true)

	star_piece_wall.ActiveState = active_state('disabled')

	merchant.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0)
end

return local_class

local local_class = newclass('SteampunkSniperPreSection')

--[[QuestAttribute

		QuestName = SteampunkSniper @
		Comment = 의뢰서를 떨어뜨리고 도망가는 헤카테 (서브스테이지 오픈) @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.get_map = function()
		return get_field_object('sniper_request_paper')
	end

	self.get_request_marker = function()
		return field:GetMarker('sniper_request_pos')
	end

	self.is_seen_talk = false

	quest_icon.PreLoad()
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.request_stage_name then
		return
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.controller.request_stage_name then
		return
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))

	if self.get_map() ~= nil then
		self.get_map().Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance
	end

	if self.map_item ~= nil then
		self.map_item:ConsumeComplete()
		self.map_item = nil
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FullEnter and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party.Leader) then
			if e.Zone.Name == 'sniper_substage_open' and not self.is_seen_talk then
				self.is_seen_talk = true
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.talk_with_sniper, self)
			end
		end

	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.get_map()) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.read_request, self)
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:talk_with_sniper()
	self.controller:progress_active_zone()

	local sniper = get_character('sniper')

	party_util.align_party(sniper, 'up', 1, 'linear')

	-- 칫, 들켰나?
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sniper)
	character_util.set_direction(sniper, 'up')
	character_util.set_anim(sniper, { name = 'rifle_idle', skip = true})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper, {key = 'steampunk_sniper_s0_1', skip = true})

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_paper_01')
	self.map_item = drop_item_util.create_item({pos = sniper.Bounds.center, target = self.get_request_marker().position,
								itemid = 20022, notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter'})
	self.get_map().Position = self.get_request_marker().position
	self.get_map().Interactable = CS.Oak.PublishInteractable.Create()
	self.get_map().Hitbox = CS.Oak.Hitbox(0.7 * unity_class.vector3.one)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		wait_for_sec(0.2)
		character_util.jump(sniper, 2, 1)
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_jingak_01')
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_jump_01')

	end))
	wp_util.move_way_points_async(sniper, {waypoints = sniper.Position + vector(0, 0, -10), speed = 6})
	character_util.set_active_state(sniper, 'disabled')

	quest_icon.SetSubstageIcon(self.get_map(), self.get_map().Position)
end

function local_class:read_request()
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.get_map())

	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Show()
	yield_return_func(stage.FieldUINarrationBox.SetNarration, stage.FieldUINarrationBox,
			game_string:GetString(game_string:Format('steampunk_sniper_s0_request', user.Name)), 0, 1)
	yield_return_func(stage.FieldUINarrationBox.SetNarration, stage.FieldUINarrationBox,
			game_string:GetString('steampunk_sniper_narration'), 0, 1)
	stage.FieldUINarrationBox:Hide()

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		wait_for_sec(1)

		if self.map_item ~= nil then
			self.map_item:ConsumeComplete()
			self.map_item = nil
		end
	end))

	self.get_map().ActiveState = active_state('disabled')
	stage_util.new_stage_theatre_show({
		substage_name = self.controller.sub_stage_name
	})
	quest_util.activate_quest(self.controller)
end

return local_class

end

function local_class:first_sniping()
	self.qte_success = false
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	local sniper = get_character('sniper')
	local tint_key = 'sniper_evasion'
	local marker = field:GetMarker('section_1_event')
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(user_party_leader, marker.position, 3,
			false, nil, nil, 'down', false)

	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = 'question', loop = false})

	attack_range_util.setup_by_direction(self.controller.sniper_attack_range, sniper.Bounds.center, sniper_dir, 0)
	attack_range_util.show(self.controller.sniper_attack_range, 0.2)

	field:Tint(tint_key, unity_color({1, 0.3216, 0.1961}), 2)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_targeted_02')

	character_util.show_emoticon_async(user_party_leader, nil, 'question')

	local sfx_targeted = music_player_util.play_sfx(	--TODO
			{sfx_name = '01_targeted_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'muted', mix = 2.0})
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_runaway_01')

	local aim = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_targetcircle_typeb_loop'):Instantiate(user_party_leader.Bounds.center)

	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'right')
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = 'embarrassed'})
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = 'surprise'})

	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	aim:Dispose()
	self.controller.sniper_attack_range:Hide()

	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_targetcircle_typeb_end'):Instantiate(user_party_leader.Bounds.center)

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	local bullet_sprite = self.controller.pooled_bullet[1].transform:GetComponent(typeof(CS.CustomSprite))
	bullet_sprite.transform.localRotation = unity_class.quaternion.LookRotation(vector(-1, 0, 0))
			* unity_class.quaternion.Euler(90, 0, 0)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.MoveTo(bullet_sprite.transform,
			user_party_leader.Position + vector(30, 0.5, 0), user_party_leader.Position + vector(2, 0.5, 0), -1, nil, 30, false))
	local smoke_effect = self.controller.get_fx_smoketrail():Instantiate(user_party_leader.Position + vector(30, 0.485, 0))

	field:Darken('qte', 0.5, 0.3)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	yield_return_func(quest_util.progress_section, self.controller)
