local local_class = newclass('SteampunkSniperSection6')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = SteampunkSniper @
		Comment = 파티에 합류를 제안하는 헤카테. 돈을 지불할시 퀘스트 완료 @
		Index = 4 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.cs_controller = controller.cs_controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec

	self.stage_name = 'substage_9_6'

	self.is_first = true

	-- 동료 연출
	self.character_card_name = 'sniper'
	self.character_title = 'sniper_character_title'
	self.character_subtitle = 'sniper_character_subtitle'
	self.character_description = 'sniper_character_description'
	self.sniper_voice_id = 36
end

function local_class:enter()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return true
	end

	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent), 'on_stage_loaded_event')

	local sniper = get_character('sniper')
	sniper.Interactable:AddListener(self.cs_controller)

	quest_icon.PreLoad()
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('fx_targetcircle_typeb')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit')
	unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('custom_sprite')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	if stage.Name ~= self.stage_name then
		return
	end
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.StageLoadedEvent))

	local sniper = get_character('sniper')

	if sniper ~= nil then
		sniper.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.cs_controller)
	end
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
end

--region on event
function local_class:on_event(e)

	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		local sniper = get_character('sniper')
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, sniper) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.hire_sniper, self, self.is_first)
			self.is_first = false
		end
		return true
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_stage_loaded_event()
	quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(get_character('sniper'))

	return false
end
--endregion

function local_class:hire_sniper(first)
	local sniper = get_character('sniper')

	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(sniper)

	party_util.align_party(sniper, 'right')

	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	character_util.stop_shake(sniper)

	if first == true then
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sniper)
		character_util.set_direction(sniper, 'right')

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
				{ key = 'steampunk_sniper_s4_27', skip = true, portraitname = 'sniper'})
		--아, 너. 아직 있었구나?

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
				{ key = 'steampunk_sniper_s4_28', skip = true, portraitname = 'sniper'})
		--됐어, 가 봐. 의뢰비도 안 나올 목숨 노려서 뭐 해.

		character_util.nod_twice(user_party_leader)

		character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'up')

		character_util.set_anim(sniper, {name = 'cross_arm'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
				{ key = 'steampunk_sniper_s4_29', skip = true, portraitname = 'sniper'})
		--아니, 잠깐.

		character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, 'left')

		character_util.set_emotion(sniper, {name = 'doyagao'})
		character_util.set_anim(sniper, {name = 'cast'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
				{ key = 'steampunk_sniper_s4_30', skip = true, portraitname = 'sniper'})
		--너 실력이 상당하던데. 그 정도면 돈 좀 모으지 않았으려나?

		character_util.remove_anim(sniper)
		character_util.set_emotion(sniper, {name = 'smile'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
				{ key = 'steampunk_sniper_s4_31', skip = true, portraitname = 'sniper'})
		--어때, 스나이퍼 한 명 필요하지 않아?

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
				{ key = 'steampunk_sniper_s4_32', skip = true, portraitname = 'sniper'})
		--미인에, 임무 수행률 높고, 성격 쿨하고. 딱 좋잖아?

		--music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_clap_01')
		local sfx_clap = music_player_util.play_sfx(
				{sfx_name = '01_clap_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc'})
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = 'smile'})
		character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = 'clap'})
		wait_for_sec(1)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party_leader)
		sfx_clap:FadeOut(1.5)

		character_util.set_emotion(sniper, {name = 'doyagao'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
				{ key = 'steampunk_sniper_s4_33', skip = true, portraitname = 'sniper'})
		--아, 물론 공짜로는 곤란해. 내가 몸값이 좀 있는 편이라.

		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
				{ key = 'steampunk_sniper_s4_34', skip = true, portraitname = 'sniper'})
		--착수금으로 50000 골드만 주면 바로 합류할게, 후훗.
	else
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
				{ key = 'steampunk_sniper_s5_4', skip = true, portraitname = 'sniper'})
		--후훗, 착수금 50000 골드, 준비 됐어?
	end

	local wait = true
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
	local answer = 0

	branches:Add({
		--환영한다(50000G)
		Text = game_string:GetString('steampunk_sniper_s5_1'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			answer = 1
			wait = false
		end})

	branches:Add({
		--거절한다
		Text = game_string:GetString('steampunk_sniper_s5_2'),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			answer = 2
			wait = false
		end})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(user_party.Leader, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if answer == 2 then
		character_util.set_emotion(sniper, {name = 'tired'})
		speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
				{ key = 'steampunk_sniper_s5_3', skip = true, portraitname = 'sniper'})
		--그래? 후회하지 않겠어?
		character_util.remove_emotion(sniper)

		quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(get_character('sniper'))
	elseif answer == 1 then
		if CS.Oak.User.Me.Gold >= 50000 then
			yield_return_func(self.ending, self)
		else
			character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sniper)
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
					{ key = 'steampunk_sniper_s5_19', skip = true, portraitname = 'sniper'})

			character_util.set_emotion(sniper, {name = 'doyagao'})
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
					{ key = 'steampunk_sniper_s5_20', skip = true, portraitname = 'sniper'})

			quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(get_character('sniper'))
		end
	end

end

		self:spine_aiming(sniper, assassins[i])

					end

					unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_lasthit'):Instantiate(assassins[i].Position)
					unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate('FX_hit'):Instantiate(assassins[i].Position + vector(0, 0.03, 0))
					local spin_state = CS.Oak.CharacterAirSpinState.Create(assassins[i], vector(3, 0, 0), 1, 0.25, true)
					message_system:Send(assassins[i].CharacterBehaviour, CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(spin_state))
				end, false))

		wait_for_sec(0.1)
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_gun_shoot_01')
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_emotion(sniper, {name = 'doyagao'})

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_gun_reload_04')
	music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
			{ key = 'steampunk_sniper_s5_14_1', skip = true, portraitname = 'sniper'})
	--흥, 별 것도 아닌 것들이 덤비긴.

	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = 'surprise'})
	character_util.normal_double_jump(user_party_leader, '01_small_jump_01')

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_gatcha_point_01')
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = 'love'})
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = 'sing'})

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(sniper)
	character_util.set_direction(sniper, 'left')

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
			{ key = 'steampunk_sniper_s5_15', skip = true, portraitname = 'sniper'})
	--후훗, 놀라긴. 착수금도 받았는데 이 정돈 기본이지.

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
			{ key = 'steampunk_sniper_s5_16', skip = true, portraitname = 'sniper'})
	--내가 괜히 비싼 게 아니라니까?

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
			{ key = 'steampunk_sniper_s5_17', skip = true, portraitname = 'sniper'})
	--어쨌거나 이렇게 된 거…

	character_util.set_animation_n_times_async(sniper, {name = 'rifle_reload', sfx = '01_gun_ready_01'})

	character_util.set_anim(sniper, {name = 'idle'})
	sniper:HideWeapon(true)

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(sniper,
			{ key = 'steampunk_sniper_s5_18', skip = true, portraitname = 'sniper'})
	--앞으로 잘 부탁해? 후훗.

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(function()
		wait_for_sec(4)
		character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party_leader)
	end))

	local sniper_character = sniper

	-- 이 시점에서 파티 멤버는 무조건 1명임
	local is_max_party = false
	local already_has_character = user:GetCharacter(CS.Oak.CharacterSpecId.Sniper, true) ~= nil

	local character_theatre_data = CS.Oak.CharacterTheatreData()
	character_theatre_data.Character = sniper_character
	character_theatre_data.CardName = self.character_card_name
	character_theatre_data.Title = game_string:GetString(self.character_title)
	character_theatre_data.Subtitle = game_string:GetString(self.character_subtitle)
	character_theatre_data.Desc = game_string:GetString(self.character_description)

local local_class = newclass('SteampunkStatueBlastingSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = SteampunkStatueBlasting @
		Comment = 스팀펑크 3의 동상 폭파 이벤트 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	-- 돌 아이템 id
	self.item_spec_name = 'princess_rock'

	-- 이벤트 존 이름
	self.statue_zone_name = 'minister_statue_zone'

	-- 오브젝트를 얻어오는 함수
	self.get_statue = controller.get_statue

	-- 캐릭터를 얻어오는 함수
	self.get_refugee = controller.get_refugee

	-- 스타 피스를 얻어오는 함수
	self.get_star_piece = controller.get_star_piece

	-- 이펙트 풀을 가져오는 함수
	self.get_explosion_effect = controller.get_explosion_effect
	self.get_hit_effect = controller.get_hit_effect
	self.get_explosion_boss_effect = controller.get_explosion_boss_effect

	self.is_saw_refugee_talk = false
	self.is_throwing_rock = true

	-- 동상 폭파 이벤트가 진행됐는가
	self.is_blasting = false

	-- 플레이어가 살아 있는가.
	self.is_user_party_leader_alive = true
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent), 'on_event')

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	local refugee_1 = self.get_refugee(1)
	local refugee_2 = self.get_refugee(2)
	local refugee_3 = self.get_refugee(3)
	local statue = self.get_statue()

	refugee_1.Position = vector(42, 0, 50)
	refugee_2.Position = vector(36, 0, 52)
	refugee_3.Position = vector(38.5, 0, 49)

	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_rock_routine, self, refugee_1, statue.Position + vector(0, 2, 0), 0.5))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_rock_routine, self, refugee_2, statue.Position + vector(0, 1.555, 0), 0.7))
	coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.throw_rock_routine, self, refugee_3, statue.Position + vector(0, 1.2, -1), 0.4))

	statue.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.WallCrashBehaviour.Instance
	statue.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent))
end

function local_class:dispose()
	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.DamageEvent) then
		return self:on_damage_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectDestroyedEvent) then
		return self:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent) then
		return self:on_field_object_revived_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			if not self.is_saw_refugee_talk and e.Zone.Name == self.statue_zone_name then
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_refugee, self))
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
	local statue = self.get_statue()

	if not self.is_blasting and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Info.target, statue) then
		local require_damage_type = CS.Oak.DamageType.Explosion | CS.Oak.DamageType.AffectGimmick

		if e.Info.type & require_damage_type == require_damage_type then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.statue_blasting, self))
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_destroyed_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		self.is_user_party_leader_alive = false
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_field_object_revived_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		self.is_user_party_leader_alive = true
		return true
	end

	return false
end

-- 동상이 터지는 연출
function local_class:statue_blasting()
	coroutine.yield()

	if not self.is_user_party_leader_alive then
		return
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

	local statue = self.get_statue()

	self.is_throwing_rock = false
	self.is_blasting = true

	-- 연출이 진행중인 동안, 플레이어가 죽지 않게 처리
	user_party_leader.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.NullDamagedBehaviour.Instance

	camera_util.move_async(statue.Position, 1)

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local refugee = self.get_refugee(i)

		character_util.set_emotion(refugee, { name = 'surprise' })
		character_util.remove_anim(refugee)
		speech_bubble_util.remove_bubble(refugee)

	end

	statue:Shake(0.1, 9999)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)

	local boss_die_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_boss_die_01', type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
	self.get_explosion_boss_effect():Instantiate(statue.Position + vector(0, 1, 0))

	local explosion_effect_loop = function()
		local position = {
			statue.Position + vector(0.5, 0.1333-0.5, 0),
			statue.Position + vector(-0.1, 0.888-0.5, 0),
			statue.Position + vector(0.9, 0.7555-0.5, 0),
			statue.Position + vector(0.6, 1.333-0.5, 0),
			statue.Position + vector(-0.6, 1.8666-0.5, 0)
		}
		local delay = {
			0.5,
			0.3,
			1,
			0.8,
			1.2
		}

		for i = 1, #position do
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_wolf_boss_bomb_01')
			self.get_explosion_effect():Instantiate(position[i])
			wait_for_sec(delay[i])
		end
	end
	yield_return_func(explosion_effect_loop)
	wait_for_sec(1.3)

	boss_die_sfx:Stop()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_explosion_02')
	screen_util.fade_out_async(0.3, unity_class.color.white ,'linear')

	statue:CancelShake()
	character_util.set_active_state(statue, 'disabled')

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local refugee = self.get_refugee(i)

		character_util.set_emotion(refugee, { name = 'smile' })

		if i < 3 then
			character_util.set_anim(refugee, { name = 'victory_extra' })
		else
			character_util.set_anim(refugee, { name = 'cast2' })
		end
	end

	wait_for_sec(1)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('01_crowd_clap_03')
	screen_util.fade_in_async(1, unity_class.color.white ,'linear')

	-- 동상을 폭파시키면 수용소민들 환호하면서 스타피스 등장

	local star_piece = self.get_star_piece()
	message_system:Send(star_piece, CS.Oak.StarPieceAppearEvent.Create(star_piece.Position))
	wait_for_sec(2)

	camera_util.return_to_leader(1)

	-- 데미지 안받게 하던걸 다시 데미지 받게
	user_party_leader.DamagedBehaviour = CS.Oak.ManualCharacterDamagedBehaviour.Create()

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)

	party_util.reset_controllers()
	field_ui_manager:Show()
end

-- 동상을 부쉈을 때 난민들의 대사
function local_class:talk_refugee()
	local refugee_2 = self.get_refugee(2)
	local refugee_3 = self.get_refugee(3)

	self.is_saw_refugee_talk = true

	-- 개자식!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(refugee_2, { key = 'steampunk_statue_blasting_1' })

	-- 이런 동상 따위!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(refugee_3, { key = 'steampunk_statue_blasting_2' })
end

-- 돌을 계속해서 던지는 루틴
function local_class:throw_rock_routine(fo, position, delay)
	while self.is_throwing_rock do
		yield_return_func(self.throw_rock_to_position, self, fo, position)

		wait_for_sec(delay)
	end
end

-- 돌 던지는 로직
function local_class:throw_rock_to_position(fo, position)
	local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')
	local item_id = item_data:GetSpec(self.item_spec_name).Id
	local rock = drop_item_util.create_item({ itemid = item_id, notforinven = true, pos = fo.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0), target = position, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.3, showoncharacter = true })

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_swing_01', parent = fo, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'npc' })
	character_util.set_anim(fo, { name = 'attack', loop = false })
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	if self.is_throwing_rock then
		character_util.remove_anim(fo)
	end

	wait_for_sec(0.2)

	music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '02_hit_projectile_01', play_pos = rock.Position, type_priority = 'event', player_priority = 'object' })
	self.get_hit_effect():Instantiate(rock.Position)

	rock:ConsumeComplete()
end

return local_class

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))

	self.current_progress = nil

	if self.stew_sfx ~= nil then
		self.stew_sfx:Stop()
		self.stew_sfx = nil
	end

	self.stew_bad_man = nil
	self.stew_counter = nil
	self.refugee_man = nil
	self.refugee_woman = nil

	self.on_stew_fail = nil
	self.player_on_line = false
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.refugee_man) then
			if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.begin then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.stew_request, self)
				return true
			elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.stew_stay then
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.stew_thanks, self)
				return true
			end
		end
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.stew_bad_man) then
			sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.say_on_line, self, 1.5)
			return true
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return false end
		if not e.FullEnter then return false end
		if e.Zone.Name == self.table_front_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress > self.progress_enum.begin and self.current_progress < self.progress_enum.order then
				-- 줄 서!!
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.say_on_line, self, -1.7)
				return true
			elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.order then
				-- 줄에 서서 주문하기
				self.player_on_line = true
			end
		end
		if e.Zone.Name == self.line_zone_name and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.idle then
			-- 줄 뒤에 서기
			self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.order
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.order_routine, self))
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent) then
		if e.FieldObject ~= user_party.Leader then return false end
		if not e.FullLeave then return false end
		if e.Zone.Name == self.ask_zone_name then
			if self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.order and self.on_stew_fail == self.stew_fail_enum.none then
				self.on_stew_fail = self.stew_fail_enum.out
				return true
			elseif self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.stew_get then
				-- 내 메이릴과 교환하지 않을래?
				sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.stew_request_for_item, self)
			end
		end
	end

	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		-- 스탠드 앞까지 달리면 실패
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.Action1TouchDown and self.current_progress == self.progress_enum.order and self.on_stew_fail == self.stew_fail_enum.none then
			self.on_stew_fail = self.stew_fail_enum.run
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:stew_reset()
	local item_point = field:GetMarker(self.item_point_name).position
	local reset_point = field:GetMarker(self.reset_point_name).position

	-- NPC 모션 리셋
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(user_party.Leader)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.stew_bad_man)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.stew_counter)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.refugee_line)

	-- 스튜 아이템 리셋
	-- 대기열 리셋
	self.refugee_line.Position = item_point + vector(-2, 0, -1)
	character_util.set_direction(self.refugee_line, 'right')

	-- 플레이어 위치 리셋
	party_util.align_party(reset_point + vector(-1, 0, 0), 'right', 0, 'linear')
	camera_util.move(user_party.Leader.Position, 0, {end_target = user_party.Leader})

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.idle
	self.player_on_line = false
end

function local_class:stew_request()
	party_util.align_to_target(self.refugee_man, 'down', 1, 'arc')

	-- 여기 배급소 스튜가 그야말로 천상의 맛인데..
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.refugee_man, {name = 'sing'}, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.refugee_man, {key = self.stew_talk .. 1, skip = true})

	-- 셰프가 엄청 까다롭단 말이지..
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.refugee_man, {name = 'question', loop = false}, {name = 'tired'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.refugee_man, {key = self.stew_talk .. 2, skip = true})

	-- 정확한 규칙대로 주문하지 않으면 엄청 욕먹고 쫓겨나!
	character_util.set_direction(self.refugee_man, 'left')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.refugee_man, {name = 'attack', sfx_name = '01_swing_01'}, {name = 'attack'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.refugee_man, {key = self.stew_talk .. 3, skip = true})

	-- 스튜 악당이란 별명이 붙을 정도라니까..!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("03_runaway_01")
	character_util.set_direction(self.refugee_man, 'down')
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.refugee_man, {name = 'cross_arm', loop = false}, {name = 'scared'})
	character_util.shake(self.refugee_man, 0.02, 9999)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.refugee_man, {key = self.stew_talk .. 4, skip = true})

	-- ..하지만 스튜가 너무 먹고 싶은데..
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.refugee_man, {name = 'idle'}, {name = 'tired'})
	character_util.stop_shake(self.refugee_man)
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.refugee_man, {key = self.stew_talk .. 5, skip = true})

	-- 혹시 도와줄 수 있어?
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.refugee_man, {name = 'sing'}, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.refugee_man, {key = self.stew_talk .. 6, skip = true})

	-- 베이컨 치즈 스튜...구해오면 꼭 보상할게.
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_clap_01")
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.refugee_man, {name = 'clap'}, {name = 'smile'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.refugee_man, {key = self.stew_talk .. 7, skip = true})

	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.refugee_man)
	self.refugee_man.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.idle
end

function local_class:say_on_line(move)
	if move > 0 then
		character_util.set_direction(self.stew_bad_man, 'right')
	end
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_player_jump_01")
	character_util.normal_jump_async(self.stew_bad_man)
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.stew_bad_man, {name = 'release'}, {name = 'mad'})
	-- 줄 서!!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_china_master_shout_01")
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.stew_bad_man, {key = self.stew_talk .. 'line', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout'})
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	if move < 0 then
		if user_party.Leader.Position.z < self.stew_bad_man.Position.z then
			character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 0, move), 0.5, nil, true, true)
		else
			character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -1 * move), 0.5, nil, true, true)
		end
	end
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.stew_bad_man)
	if move > 0 then
		character_util.set_direction(self.stew_bad_man, 'left')
	end
end

function local_class:order_routine()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local item_point = field:GetMarker(self.item_point_name).position

	self.stew_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({ sfx_name = '01_boiling_01', loop = true, type_priority = 'loop', player_priority = 'default', fade_in_time = 2 })

	camera_util.move(item_point + vector(0, 0, -1), 0.5)
	party_util.align_to_target(self.refugee_line, 'left', 0.7, 'linear')
	party_util.set_direction('right')
	yield_return_func(self.NPC_order, self)

	yield_return_func(self.player_order, self)
end

function local_class:NPC_order()
	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	local item_point = field:GetMarker(self.item_point_name).position
	local bad_man_pos = self.stew_bad_man.Position
	local counter_pos = self.stew_counter.Position

	-- 앞으로 걸어간다.
	character_util.move_to_async(self.refugee_line, self.refugee_line.Position + vector(1, 0, 0), 1, nil, true, true)

	party_util.align_to_target(self.refugee_line, 'left', 0.7, 'linear')
	-- 안녕하세요!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.refugee_line, {key = self.stew_talk .. 8, skip = true})

	-- 잠발라야 스튜 한 개!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.refugee_line, {key = self.stew_talk .. 9, skip = true})

	-- 부탁합니다!
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.refugee_line, {key = self.stew_talk .. 10, skip = true})

	character_util.move_to_async(self.refugee_line, self.refugee_line.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.7), 0.5, nil, false, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(self.refugee_line, self.refugee_line.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.8), 0.5, nil, false, true)

	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.set_direction(self.stew_bad_man, 'down')
	character_util.move_to_async(self.stew_bad_man, bad_man_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.75), 0.3, nil, false, false)
	character_util.move_to_async(self.stew_bad_man, bad_man_pos + vector(0, 0, -1), 0.2, nil, false, false)
	character_util.set_anim(self.stew_bad_man, {name = 'gauntlet_idle'})
	self.stew_bad_man.SpineController:SetAttachment("[base]weapon1", "cup_stew")
	character_util.move_to_async(self.stew_bad_man, bad_man_pos, 0.4, nil, false, false)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	character_util.set_direction(self.stew_bad_man, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(self.stew_counter, 'down')
	character_util.move_to_async(self.stew_counter, bad_man_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5), 0.3, nil, false, false)
	character_util.move_to_async(self.stew_counter, bad_man_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.25), 0.2, nil, false, false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.stew_bad_man)
	character_util.set_anim(self.stew_counter, {name = 'gauntlet_idle'})
	self.stew_bad_man.SpineController:SetAttachment("[base]weapon1", "empty")
	self.stew_counter.SpineController:SetAttachment("[base]weapon1", "cup_stew")
	character_util.set_direction(self.stew_bad_man, 'left')
	character_util.move_to_async(self.stew_counter, counter_pos, 0.6, nil, false, false)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	character_util.set_direction(self.stew_counter, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.stew_counter)

	-- 스튜 던져줌.
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_throw_01")
	self.stew_counter.SpineController:SetAttachment("[base]weapon1", "empty")
	local stew = drop_item_util.create_item({ itemid = self.zambalaya_stew_id, pos = self.stew_counter.Position, target = self.refugee_line.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0),
											  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.7 })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 스튜를 받고 물러남.
	character_util.set_emotion(self.refugee_line, {name = 'smile'})
	stew.ConsumeTarget = self.refugee_line
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.refugee_line, {
		item_point + vector(-7, 0, 0.5),
		item_point + vector(-7, 0, 7)
	}, 6, false, nil, nil, nil)

	self.refugee_line.Position = vector(999, 0, 999)

	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:player_order()
	self.on_stew_fail = self.stew_fail_enum.none

	local bad_man_pos = self.stew_bad_man.Position
	local counter_pos = self.stew_counter.Position

	-- 앞으로 걸어갈 때 뛰는지 체크
	while not self.player_on_line do
		if self.on_stew_fail == self.stew_fail_enum.run then
			-- 뛰지마!
			yield_return_func(self.no_stew_for_you, self, 2)
			return
		end
		if self.on_stew_fail == self.stew_fail_enum.out then
			-- 어디가!
			yield_return_func(self.no_stew_for_you, self, 1)
			return
		end
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	party_util.align_party(self.stew_bad_man.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0), 'left', 0.5, 'linear')

	local waitForBranch = true
	local order = 0

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

	for i = 1, 4 do
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString(self.stew_branch .. 0),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
			Callback = function()
				order = 1
				waitForBranch = false
			end})
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString(self.stew_branch .. 1),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
			Callback = function()
				order = 2
				waitForBranch = false
			end
		})
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString(self.stew_branch .. 2),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
			Callback = function()
				order = 3
				waitForBranch = false
			end
		})
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString(self.stew_branch .. 3),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
			Callback = function()
				order = 4
				waitForBranch = false
			end
		})

		local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
		choice_state.Branchs = branches
		choice_state.Talker = user_party.Leader
		ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)

		while waitForBranch do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		-- 순서가 틀리면 틀린 순서를 지적 당하고 쫒겨남
		if i ~= order then
			self.on_stew_fail = self.stew_fail_enum.order
			yield_return_func(self.no_stew_for_you, self, i + 3)
			return
		end

		branches:Clear()

		waitForBranch = true
		order = 0
	end

	-- 주문에 성공함
	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.7), 0.5, nil, false, true)
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.move_to_async(user_party.Leader, user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0, 0, 0.8), 0.5, nil, false, true)

	wait_for_sec(1)
	character_util.set_direction(self.stew_bad_man, 'down')
	character_util.move_to_async(self.stew_bad_man, bad_man_pos + vector(0, 0, -0.75), 0.3, nil, false, false)
	character_util.move_to_async(self.stew_bad_man, bad_man_pos + vector(0, 0, -1), 0.2, nil, false, false)
	character_util.set_anim(self.stew_bad_man, {name = 'gauntlet_idle'})
	self.stew_bad_man.SpineController:SetAttachment("[base]weapon1", "cup_stew")
	character_util.move_to_async(self.stew_bad_man, bad_man_pos, 0.4, nil, false, false)
	wait_for_sec(0.1)
	character_util.set_direction(self.stew_bad_man, 'left')
	character_util.set_direction(self.stew_counter, 'down')
	character_util.move_to_async(self.stew_counter, bad_man_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.5), 0.3, nil, false, false)
	character_util.move_to_async(self.stew_counter, bad_man_pos + vector(0, 0, 0.25), 0.2, nil, false, false)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.stew_bad_man)
	character_util.set_anim(self.stew_counter, {name = 'gauntlet_idle'})
	self.stew_bad_man.SpineController:SetAttachment("[base]weapon1", "empty")
	self.stew_counter.SpineController:SetAttachment("[base]weapon1", "cup_stew")
	character_util.set_direction(self.stew_bad_man, 'left')
	character_util.move_to_async(self.stew_counter, counter_pos, 0.6, nil, false, false)
	wait_for_sec(0.2)
	character_util.set_direction(self.stew_counter, 'left')
	wait_for_sec(0.5)
	character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.stew_counter)

	-- 스튜 던져줌.
	self.stew_counter.SpineController:SetAttachment("[base]weapon1", "empty")
	local stew = drop_item_util.create_item({ itemid = self.stew_id, pos = self.stew_counter.Position, target = user_party.Leader.Position + vector(0.3, 0, 0),
											  notforinven = true, lootstate = 'dontfindlooter', sprscale = 0.7 })
	wait_for_sec(1.5)

	-- 스튜를 받고 물러남.
	stew.ConsumeTarget = user_party.Leader
	wait_for_sec(0.5)

	self.current_progress = self.progress_enum.stew_get

	camera_util.move_async(user_party.Leader.Position, 0.5, {end_target = user_party.Leader})
	self.refugee_man.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	self.stew_sfx:FadeOut(2)
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()
end

function local_class:stew_request_for_item()
	local init_pos = self.refugee_woman.Position
	local bad_man_pos = self.stew_bad_man.Position
	local player_pos = user_party.Leader.Position

	camera_util.move_async(self.refugee_woman.Position, 0.5, {end_target = self.refugee_woman})
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_small_jump_01")
	character_util.normal_jump_async(self.refugee_woman)
	character_util.move_waypoint_async(self.refugee_woman, {
		vector(player_pos.x - 1.5, 0, init_pos.z),
		vector(player_pos.x - 1.5, 0, player_pos.z)
	}, 7, true, 'stop', nil, 'right', true)
	party_util.align_party(self.refugee_woman.Position + vector(0.5, 0, 0), 'right', 0.3, 'arc')
	character_util.set_direction(user_party.Leader, 'left')

	-- 그, 그 스튜….!
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("01_gatcha_point_01")
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.refugee_woman, {name = 'sing'}, {name = 'love'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.refugee_woman, {key = self.stew_talk .. 11, skip = true})

	-- 부탁이야...그거 나한테 넘겨주지 않을래?
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.refugee_woman, {name = 'shoot'}, {name = 'tired'})
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.refugee_woman, {key = self.stew_talk .. 12, skip = true})

	-- 아르마다를 보여주며
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("02_admiral_rush_01")
	self.refugee_woman.SpineController:SetAttachment("[base]weapon1", "cwp_admiral")
	character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.refugee_woman, {name = 'victory_get', loop = false, sfx_name = '01_small_jump_01'}, {name = 'smile'})
	wait_for_sec(1)
	-- 대신이라곤 뭣하지만 주변에서 주은 이걸 넘겨줄게.
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.refugee_woman, {key = self.stew_talk .. 13, skip = true})

	local waitForBranch = true
	local choice = false

	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

	-- 스튜는 신성한거야!
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.stew_branch .. 4),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			choice = true
			waitForBranch = false
		end})
	-- 교환한다.
	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(self.stew_branch .. 5),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Normal,
		Callback = function()
			choice = false
			waitForBranch = false
		end
	})

	local choice_state = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
	choice_state.Branchs = branches
	choice_state.Talker = user_party.Leader
	ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, choice_state)

	while waitForBranch do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	-- 신성한거야! 선택시
	if choice then
		-- 윽...깐깐해..
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("03_dialogue_tipsy_01")

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.crystal_lab_zone_name = 'crystal_lab_'

	self.x_log_item_name = 'x_log_item'

	self.star_piece_name = controller.star_piece_name

	-- 캐릭터를 가져오는 함수
	self.get_champion = function(num)
		local name = 'crystal_champion_' .. num

		if num == 4 then
			name = name .. self.controller.china_hero_name
		elseif num == 8 then
			name = name .. self.controller.knight_hero_name
		end

		return get_character(name)
	end
	self.get_cyborg = function() return get_character('crystal_cyborg') end

	self.champion_list = nil

	self.is_champion_fade_out_list = nil
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')

	local cyborg = self.get_cyborg()
	character_util.set_direction(cyborg, 'left')
	cyborg.Position = vector(86.5, 0, 100.5)
	cyborg.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)

	self.is_champion_fade_out_list = {}
	local champion_position_list = {
		vector(75.5, 0, 115.5),
		vector(79.5, 0, 115.5),
		nil,
		vector(87.5, 0, 115.5),
		vector(91.5, 0, 115.5),
		vector(95.5, 0, 115.5),
		vector(99.5, 0, 115.5),
		vector(103.5, 0, 115.5)
	}
	for i = 1, 8 do
		local champion = self.get_champion(i)

		if champion ~= nil then
			if i ~= 8 then
				character_util.set_direction(champion, 'left')
			else
				character_util.set_direction(champion, 'down')
			end
			champion.Position = champion_position_list[i]
			character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(champion, 0.75, 0)
			self.is_champion_fade_out_list[i] = false
			field_ui_manager:RemoveUI(champion, CS.Oak.FieldUiType.CharacterStats)
		end
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:start()
	local knight = self.get_champion(8)
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	local cyborg = self.get_cyborg()
	cyborg.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
end

function local_class:dispose()
	if self.champion_list ~= nil then
		for i = 1, 8 do
			self.champion_list[i] = nil
		end
		self.champion_list = nil
	end
	self.is_champion_fade_out_list = nil

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	if lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		return self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif lua_helper.type_compare(e, CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		return self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	local cyborg = self.get_cyborg()

	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, cyborg) then
		sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.interact_cyborg, self)
		return true
	end

	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			for i = 1, 8 do
				if not self.is_champion_fade_out_list[i] and e.Zone.Name == self.crystal_lab_zone_name .. i then
					coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.champion_fade_out, self, i))
					return true
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

-- 지금까지 만난 챔피언들이 사라지는 연출
function local_class:champion_fade_out(index)
	local champion = self.get_champion(index)
	local direction = vector(0, 0, 3)

	self.is_champion_fade_out_list[index] = true

	if index == 8 then
		direction = vector(-3, 0, 0)
		wait_for_sec(0.5)
	else
		if index % 2 == 0 then
			direction = -direction
		end
		champion.SpineController:AddColor('red', unity_class.color.red, 1, 0.6)
	end

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(champion, 0, 1)
	character_util.move_to_async(champion, champion.Position + direction, 1, nil, true, true)

	champion.SpineController:RemoveColor('red', 0)
	character_util.set_active_state(champion, 'disabled')
end

-- 사이보그에게 상호작용
function local_class:interact_cyborg()
	local cyborg = self.get_cyborg()

	party_util.align_to_target(cyborg, 'left', 1, 'arc')

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cyborg, { key = 'steampunk_crystal_mining_road_1', skip = true })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cyborg, { key = 'steampunk_crystal_mining_road_2', skip = true })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cyborg, { key = 'steampunk_crystal_mining_road_3', skip = true })

	yield_return_func(self.get_x_log, self)

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('03_dialogue_worker_01')
	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cyborg, { key = 'steampunk_crystal_mining_road_4', skip = true })

	speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(cyborg, { key = 'steampunk_crystal_mining_road_5', skip = true })

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(cyborg, 0, 1)
	wait_for_sec(1)

	character_util.set_active_state(cyborg, 'disabled')

	yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, false, false, false)
end

-- X-Log를 얻는 연출
function local_class:get_x_log()
	local x_log = get_field_object(self.x_log_item_name)

	-- floating 아이템 획득처리
	stage:SendPickStageItem(x_log.Name, nil, function(data)
		local has_value, value = data:TryGetValue('AddedItem')
		local added_item = value

		if added_item ~= nil then
			CS.Oak.StageProgress.Current:AddItem(x_log.KeyIndex)

			has_value, value = added_item:TryGetValue('Id')
			local item_id = value

			has_value, value = user.Items:TryGetValue(item_id)
			if has_value then
				CS.Oak.AddItemStageLogic.Execute(value, user_party_leader)
			end
		end
	end)

	local tape_id = x_log.FieldObjectBehaviour.Item.ItemId
	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ItemGetEvent, { ItemId = tape_id, NotForInventory = true }, 'x_log_video_title', 'x_log_video_desc')

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.VideoFoundEvent.Create(tape_id))
end

return local_class

    self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
    local event_type = e:GetType()
    if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
        local guide = get_character(self.guide_name)

        if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, guide) then
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.quest_request, self))
        end
    end

    return false
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

function local_class:quest_request()
    local guide = get_character(self.guide_name)

    quest_icon.RemoveIcon(guide)
    field_ui_manager:Hide()
    party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

    if self.is_watch == false then
        coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:TownQuestRequest())

        local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
        local wait_for_branch = true
        local know = false

        branches:Add({
            Text = game_string:GetString("bt_yes"),
            Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
            Callback = function()
                wait_for_branch = false
                know = true
            end
        })
        branches:Add({
            Text = game_string:GetString("bt_no"),
            Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
            Callback = function()
                wait_for_branch = false
                know = false
            end
        })

        local acs = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
        acs.Branchs = branches
        acs.Talker = user_party[0]

        ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, acs)

        while wait_for_branch do
            coroutine.yield(nil)
        end

        if know == true then
            coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:TownQuestRequest_knew())
        else
            coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:TownQuestRequest_unknew())
        end
        self.is_watch = true
    end

    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guide, { key = 'succubus_town_s0_18', skip = true })

    local accepted = quest_util.process_quest_request(self.quest_spec.QuestId)
    if accepted then
        floating_text_util.activate_for_quest(user_party[0], self.quest_spec.QuestName, 0)

        coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.QuestAcceptEvent(false, false))

        coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:TownQuestAccept())
        coroutine.yield(quest_util.activate_quest(self.controller))
    else
        quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(guide)
    end

    coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.0))

    field_ui_manager:Show()
    party_util.reset_controllers()
end

return local_class

        if e.FullEnter == true and e.FieldObject == user_party_leader then

                    self.therapy_cnt = self.therapy_cnt + 1
                    ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('succubusTown_' .. i - 1)
                    self:check_and_apply()
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false

end

function local_class:check_therapy()
    if self.therapy_cnt >= 3 then

        guide.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
        quest_icon.RemoveIcon(guide)
        ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('succubusTown')
        party_util.stop_and_disable_control()
        field_ui_manager:Hide()

        coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:TownQuestClear())
        coroutine.yield(quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0, true, true, false))
        local item_data = game_data_service.GetData('ItemData')
        coroutine.yield(CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ItemGetEvent({ ItemId = item_data:GetSpec('succubus_vip').Id }, 'vip_membership_title', 'vip_membership_subtitle', 'vip_membership_desc'))

function local_class:talk_branch()

    local good = false

    branches:Add({
        Text = game_string:GetString('succubus_town_s1_10'),
        Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
        Callback = function()
            wait_for_branch = false
            good = false
        end
    })
    branches:Add({
        Text = game_string:GetString('succubus_town_s1_8'),
        Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
        Callback = function()
            wait_for_branch = false
            good = true
        end
    })

    local acs = CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoiceState()
    acs.Branchs = branches
    acs.Talker = user_party[0]

    ui_scene_manager:PushOverlay(CS.Oak.UI.AnswerChoice.Instance, acs)

    while wait_for_branch do
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    local guide = get_character(self.guide_name)
    if good == true then
        speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guide, { key = 'succubus_town_s1_9', skip = true })
    else
        speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(guide, { key = 'succubus_town_s1_11', skip = true })
    end

function local_class:check_and_apply()
    local guide_talk =
    {
        [0] = 'succubus_town_s1_1',
        [1] = 'succubus_town_s1_2|succubus_town_s1_3',
        [2] = 'succubus_town_s1_4'
    }

    local guide = get_character(self.guide_name)
    if self.therapy_cnt < 3 then
        guide.Interactable.Talk = guide_talk[self.therapy_cnt]
    else
        guide.Interactable.Talk = ''
        guide.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
        for i = 1, 4 do
            ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker('succubusTown_' .. i - 1)
        end
        quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(guide)
    end
    quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
    local desc = game_string:Format('succubus_town_s1_0', self.therapy_cnt)
    quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, desc)
end

return local_class

function local_class:load_teatan_bg()
    coroutine.yield(screen_util.fade_out_async(0.75, unity_class.color.white, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear))

    music_player:PlayStageMusic(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Muted)

    local bg_pos = vector(300, 0, 300)
    local resholder = CS.Foundations.ResourceHolder()
    local bg_transform
    coroutine.yield(CS.Foundations.IResourceHolderExtensions.LoadPrefabAsync(resholder, "theatres/teatans_robots", "theatre_teatans_robots", function(prefab)
        bg_transform = CS.UnityEngine.GameObject.Instantiate(prefab).transform
        bg_transform.position = bg_pos
    end))

    stage_camera:Move(bg_pos, 0)
    stage_camera:ResizeToDefault(0)

    coroutine.yield(screen_util.fade_in_async(0.2, unity_class.color.white, CS.Oak.Interpolations.Linear))

    coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1.0))
    stage_camera:Shake(0.5, 3.25)

    music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("02_explosion_02")
    music_player:PlaySfxOneShot("02_lastsnipe_01")

    local energy_pos = bg_transform:Find("custom_sprite/demon_1").position
    local laser = self.laser_effect_pool:Instantiate(energy_pos, unity_class.quaternion.Euler(0, 90, 0), nil)
    local scaling_effect = laser:GetComponent(typeof(CS.Oak.ScalingLaserEffect))
    local t = 2.5
    local tp = 0

    while tp <= t do
        local progress = CS.UnityEngine.Mathf.Clamp01(tp / t)

				self.see_intro = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.intro_event, self))

function local_class:on_event(e)

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BurnEvent) then
		self:on_burn_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent) then
		self:on_field_object_revived_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		self:on_custom_Stage_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.teatan_guard) then
		if self.cleared_request == 3 then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(
					stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.complete_request, self))
		else
			speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.teatan_guard, self.talk_name)
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_burn_event(e)
	for i = 1, #self.campfire_list do
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.campfire_list[i]) then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name3[i])
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.monster_group_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ending, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_field_object_revived_event(e)
	if self.is_fight and lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
		for i = 1, #self.invader_list do
			stage.BattleManager:AddToNoticeGroup(self.monster_group_name, self.invader_list[i])
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_custom_Stage_event(e)
	if e.Params.Length == 1 then
		if e.Params[0] == self.custom_stage_key1 then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name2)
		elseif e.Params[0] == self.custom_stage_key2 then
			for i = 1, #self.campfire_list do
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name3[i])
			end
		elseif e.Params[0] == self.custom_stage_key3 then
			ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name4)
		end

		if e.Params[0] == self.custom_stage_key1 or e.Params[0] == self.custom_stage_key2 or e.Params[0] == self.custom_stage_key3 then
			self.cleared_request = self.cleared_request + 1

			if self.cleared_request ~= 3 then
				quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
				quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name1) ..
						" : " .. self.cleared_request .. " / " .. 3)
			else
				quest_icon.RemoveIcon(self.teatan_guard)
				quest_icon.SetQuestCleared(self.teatan_guard)

				ui_quest_marker:AddQuestMarkerToIFO(self.marker_name1, self.quest_spec.QuestId,
						self.quest_spec.IsStoryQuest, self.teatan_guard)

				quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)
				quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name2))
			end
		end
	end


end

	quest_tracker:RemoveQuest(self.quest_spec)

	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:invade())

	for i = 1, #self.invader_list do
		character_util.convert_to_monster(self.invader_list[i], self.monster_group_name)
		command_util.execute_monster_notice(self.invader_list[i], user_party_leader, "battle")

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battle_Gate_name))

	quest_tracker:AddQuest(self.quest_spec, game_string:GetString(self.tracker_name3))
	stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party_leader)

	user_party:ResetControllers()

	for i =  1, #self.campfire_teatan_list do

	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()
	coroutine.yield(self.controller.scene:ending())
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battle_Gate_name))
	coroutine.yield(quest_util.complete_quest(self.controller, 0))
	stage_camera:SetTarget(user_party_leader)
	field_ui_manager:Show()
	user_party:ResetControllers()

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.35))
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent.Create(self.teatan_guard, { 'shivering_sound_on' }))
end

	coroutine.yield(self:fall_down(il, true))

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.guard_scream_sfx_handle_name)

	character_util.set_direction(self.teatan_guard, "left")
	character_util.set_anim(self.teatan_guard, {name = "prostrate"})

	local campfire1_list = {}
	local campfire2_list = {}
	local campfire3_list = {}
	local campfire4_list = {}
	local campfire5_list = {}

	local start_pos = c.Position
	local end_pos = vector(start_pos.x, 0, start_pos.z)
	local free_fall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(fall_time, start_pos.y, 0)

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < fall_time do
		free_fall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local cur_y = free_fall:GetDistance()

		character_util.set_position(c, vector(start_pos.x, start_pos.y + cur_y, start_pos.z), true)

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.crash_Sfx_handle_name)

	if c_big then
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.big_butt_bounce_effect_preset):Instantiate(c.Position +
		vector(0, 0.5, 0))
	else
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.small_butt_bounce_effect_preset):Instantiate(c.Position)
	end

	camera_util.shake(0.4, 0.3)
	character_util.set_position(c, end_pos, false)

	end

end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()

	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		if e.FullEnter and e.FieldObject == user_party_leader and e.Zone.Name == self.zone_name then
			if self.see_intro == false then
				self.see_intro = true
				coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.intro_event, self))
			end
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.Target, self.erina) then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.talk_with_erina, self))
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.ending, self))
		end
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.FieldObjectRevivedEvent) then
		if lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name1))
			message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name2))
		end
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:intro_event()
	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "victim_intro")
end

function local_class:talk_with_erina()
	local erina = self.erina
	local scene = self.controller.scene
	quest_icon.RemoveIcon(erina)
	field_ui_manager:Hide()

	character_util.align_party(erina, "right")

	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "talk_with_erina")

	for i=1, 3 do
		local wait_for_branch = true
		local check = false

		local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))
		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString(string.format('%s%d_%d', self.talk_branch_name, i, 0)),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
			Callback = function()
				wait_for_branch = false
				check = true
			end
		})

		branches:Add({
			Text = game_string:GetString(string.format('%s%d_%d', self.talk_branch_name, i, 1)),
			Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
			Callback = function()
				wait_for_branch = false
			end
		})

		ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(erina, branches)

		while wait_for_branch do
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		if check == true then
			local scene_name = string.format('%s%d_%d', self.answer_scene_name, i, 1)
			yield_return(self.controller.scene, scene_name)
			quest_icon.SetQuestNotice(erina)
			break
		else
			local scene_name = string.format('%s%d_%d', self.answer_scene_name, i, 2)
			yield_return(self.controller.scene, scene_name)

			if i == 3 then
				self.prev_stage_field_bgm_name = music_player.StageFieldMusicName

				music_player:RemoveStageMusicClip(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field)

				character_util.convert_to_monster(erina, self.battle_group_name)
				character_util.set_death_type(erina, "none")
				character_util.set_emotion(erina, {name = "mad"})

				command_util.execute_monster_notice(erina, user_party_leader, "battle")
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.SNSSetEquipmentRecommendationEvent.Create(false))
				ui_quest_marker:RemoveQuestMarker(self.marker_name);

				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name1))
				message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateCloseEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name2))
			end
		end

	character_util.set_direction(self.erina, CS.Oak.DirectionExtensions.GetSideDirection(self.erina.Direction))

	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.BattleGateOpenEvent.Create(self.battle_gate_name2))

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	user_party:StopAndDisableControl()

	yield_return(self.controller.scene, "ending")

	music_player:PlayStageMusic(self.prev_stage_field_bgm_name, CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Field, 1)

function local_class:erina_talk_branch()
	local wait = true
	local mercy = false
	local branches = create_generic_list(typeof(CS.Oak.TalkBranch))

	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(string.format("%s%d", self.talk_branch_name, 0)),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Mercy,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
			mercy = true
		end})

	branches:Add({
		Text = game_string:GetString(string.format("%s%d", self.talk_branch_name, 1)),
		Tendency = CS.Oak.TalkTendency.Brutal,
		Callback = function()
			wait = false
		end})

	ui_overlay_util.push_overlay(self.erina, branches)

	while wait do
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	if mercy then
		for i = 1, 2 do
			character_util.spine_deviate_local(user_party_leader, vector(-0.5, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)
			character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = "spear_attack", loop = false})
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.hit_sfx_name)

			coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

			character_util.spine_deviate_local(self.erina, vector(-0.3, 0, 0), 0.3, 0.2)

			coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.2))

			CS.Oak.CharacterAnimationSfxExtensions.UnsubscribeAndRemoveSfxHandler(user_party_leader)
			user_party_leader:RemoveAnimation()

			coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))
		end
	else
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = "doyagao"})
		yield_return_func(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.MoveTo,
				user_party_leader, vector(-33.5, 0, 0), nil, 2, true, true)

		character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = "eat"})
		music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = self.equipping_sfx_name, loop = true, duration = 2})
		character_util.shake(self.erina, 0.04, 2)

		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(2))
	end
end

function local_class:portal_spawn()
	self.erina.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self.erina.Holdable = CS.Oak.Holdable()

	field:Tint(self.tint_key_name, unity_color({0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1}), 1)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.earthquake_sfx_name)
	music_player:PlayStageMusic(CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Muted)
	camera_util.shake(0.15, 1)

	for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.set_direction(user_party[i], "right")
		character_util.jump(user_party[i], 1, 0.5)
		user_party[i]:RemoveAnimation()
		user_party[i]:RemoveEmotion()
	end

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(1))
	camera_util.move(vector(-32, 0, 0), 1)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 1)
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.cast_magic3_sfx_name)

	self.portal_ambience_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = self.cast_magic1_sfx_name,
	loop = true, volume = 0.6, type_priority = "loop", player_priority = "object"})

	self.portal = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.portal_spawn_effect_name):Instantiate(vector(-32, 0, 0.5))

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		local mod
		if i % 2 == 0 then
			mod = 1
		else
			mod = -1
		end

		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.hit_effect_name):Instantiate(user_party[i].Position)
		unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.last_hit_effect_name):Instantiate(user_party[i].Position)

		character_util.spine_rotate(user_party[i], 720, 0.5)
		character_util.jump(user_party[i], 2, 0.5)
		user_party[i].SpineController:DamageSquish(1)
		user_party[i].SpineController:DamageRedPulse()
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], {name = "damaged"})
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], {name = "damaged"})

		local knock_back_info = character_util.knockback_info(
				"physics", true, vector(-1, 0, mod * i * 0.5), 20000, 0.05,
				CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient)
		local ckms = CS.Oak.CharacterKnockBackState.Create(user_party[i], knock_back_info)
		user_party[i].FieldObjectBehaviour:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(ckms))
	end

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.lilith, 0, 0)
	character_util.set_direction(self.lilith, "left")

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	self.lilith.Position = vector(-32, 0, 0)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.lilith, 1, 1)

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.MoveTo,
			self.lilith, vector(-33, 0, 0), 0.2, nil, true, true)

	for i = 0, user_party.Count - 1 do
		character_util.spine_rotate(user_party[i], 0, 0)
		character_util.set_anim(user_party[i], {name = "hurt"})
		character_util.set_emotion(user_party[i], {name = "confused"})
	end
end

function local_class:portal_closed()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.earthquake_sfx_name)
	camera_util.shake(0.3, 1.3)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

	yield_return_func(CS.Oak.IFieldObjectExtensions.MoveTo,
			self.lilith, vector(-32, 0, 0), 0.2, nil, true, true)

	field:RemoveTint(self.tint_key_name, 0.5)
	self.portal:Dispose()
	music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.ficklelady_sfx_name)
	self.portal_ambience_sfx:FadeOut()

	local portal_end = unity_object_pool.GetOrCreate(self.portal_remove_effect_name):Instantiate(
			vector(-32, 0, 0.5))

	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.lilith, 0, 0.3)
	character_util.spine_set_alpha_fade(self.erina, 0, 0.3)

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3))

	character_util.set_active_state(self.lilith, "disabled")
	character_util.set_active_state(self.erina, "disabled")

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.2))

	portal_end:Dispose()
	party_util.remove_emotion()
	party_util.remove_animation()
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

return local_class

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
	self.controller = controller
	self.quest_spec = quest_spec
	self.scene = controller.scene
	self.quest_progress = controller.quest_progress

	self.vampire_girl = nil
	self.vampire_girl_battle = nil
	self.audios_source_holder = nil

	self.inshinezone = false
	self.skip_request = false
	self.already_know_vampire_girl = false

	self.vampire_girl_name = "vampire_bad_girl"
	self.vampire_girl_battle_name = "vampire_bad_girl_for_battle"

	self.blood_sucking_custom_state_name = "bloodsucking"
	self.meet_custom_state_name = "vampire_girl_meet"

	self.battle_group_name = "vampire_girl"

	self.come_vampire_zone_name = "come_vampire"
	self.end_vampire_zone_name = "end_vampire"

	self.marker_name1 = "vampire_bad_girl"

	self.tracker_name1 = "vampire_bad_girl_tracker_0"

	self.talk_name1 = "vampire_bad_girl_script_0"
	self.talk_name2 = "vampire_bad_girl_script_1"

	self.battle_gate_name = "vampire_battlegate_"
	self.shot_cut_door_name = "vampire_shortcut"

	self.boss_title_name = "vampirebadgirl_title"
	self.boss_subtitle_name = "vampirebadgirl_desc"

	self.die_vampire_sfx_name = "02_die_vampire_01"

	--scene name
	self.scene_forest_out = "forest_out"
	self.scene_request_vampire_girl = "request_vampire_girl"
	self.scene_request_vampire_girl_add = "request_vampire_girl_add"
	self.scene_fight_with_vampire = "fight_with_vampire"
	self.scene_blood_sucking = "blood_sucking"
	self.scene_ending_1 = "ending_1"

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadTutorialSpine()
	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.PreloadBossTitle()
end

function local_class:enter()
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.WaypointOpenedEvent), 'on_event')
	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.WaypointClosedEvent), 'on_event')

	self.vampire_girl = get_character(self.vampire_girl_name)
	if self.controller.starting_inner_progress >= 0 then
		self.vampire_girl.Interactable:AddListener(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end
	self.vampire_girl_battle = get_character(self.vampire_girl_battle_name)
	character_util.set_active_state(self.vampire_girl_battle, "disabled")

	self.scene:add_callback('VampireDropGold', { controller = self, func = self.vampire_drop_gold } )
	self.scene:add_callback('VampireMonsterEffect', { controller = self, func = self.vampire_monster_effect } )
	self.scene:add_callback('OpenShortCutDoor', { controller = self, func = self.open_shortcut_door } )
	self.scene:add_callback('GiveBloodSuckDamage', { controller = self, func = self.give_blood_suck_damage } )

	return true

function local_class:start()
	if self.quest_progress:GetCustomState(self.meet_custom_state_name) == 1 then
		self:open_shortcut_door()
	end

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.WaypointOpenedEvent))
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.WaypointClosedEvent))

	if self.vampire_girl.Interactable:GetType() == typeof(CS.Oak.NPCInteractable) then
		self.vampire_girl.Interactable:RemoveRelatedEvent(self.controller.cs_controller)
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil
	self.scene = nil

	self.vampire_girl = nil
	self.vampire_girl_battle = nil
	self.audios_source_holder = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.InteractEvent) then
		self:on_interact_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.CustomStageEvent) then
		self:on_custom_stage_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent) then
		self:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.WaypointOpenedEvent) then
		self:on_waypoint_opened_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.WaypointClosedEvent) then
		self:on_waypoint_closed_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if e.FullEnter == false then return	end
	local fo_is_partyleader = e.FieldObject == user_party_leader
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if fo_is_partyleader then
		if zone_name == self.come_vampire_zone_name and
				self.controller.current_quest_state == self.controller.vampire_quest_states.none then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.vampire_girl_emerge, self))
		elseif zone_name == self.end_vampire_zone_name and
				self.controller.current_quest_state == self.controller.vampire_quest_states.proceed then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.goaway_vampire_girl, self))
		elseif zone_name == self.enter_shine_zone_name then
			self.inshinezone = not self.inshinezone

			if self.inshinezone then
				speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.vampire_girl, {key = self.talk_name1, auto_layout = true})
				character_util.set_emotion(self.vampire_girl, {name = "tired"})
			else
				self.vampire_girl:RemoveEmotion()
			end
		end
	elseif e.FieldObject == self.vampire_girl and zone_name == self.shine_zone_name then
		if self.controller.current_quest_state == self.controller.vampire_quest_states.proceed then
			coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.fight_vampire_girl, self))
		end
	end
end

function local_class:on_interact_event(e)
	if e.Target == self.vampire_girl and
			self.controller.current_quest_state == self.controller.vampire_quest_states.start then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.request_vampire_girl, self))
	end
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
	if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.die_vampire_sfx_name)
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.beat_vampire_girl, self))

	self.vampire_girl = get_character(self.vampire_girl_name)
	self.vampire_girl_battle = get_character(self.vampire_girl_battle_name)
	character_util.set_active_state(self.vampire_girl_battle, "disabled")

	self.controller.scene:add_callback('VampireRaid', { controller = self, func = self.vampire_raid } )
	self.controller.scene:add_callback('StickVampire', { controller = self, func = self.stick_vampire } )
	self.controller.scene:add_callback('ResetVampireRotation', { controller = self, func = self.reset_vampire_rotation } )

function local_class:start()
	message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.DoorOpenEvent.Create(self.shot_cut_door_name))
end

function local_class:exit()
	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))

	if self.listening_touch_event then
		message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	end

	self.controller = nil
	self.quest_progress = nil
	self.quest_spec = nil

	self.vampire_girl = nil
	self.audios_source_holder = nil
end

function local_class:on_event(e)
	local event_type = e:GetType()
	if event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent) then
		self:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	elseif event_type == typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent) then
		return self:on_touch_event(e)
	end
	return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
	if not e.FullEnter then return end
	if not lua_helper.reference_equals(e.FieldObject, user_party_leader) then return end
	local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

	if zone_name == self.come_vampire_zone_name then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.finish_quest, self))
	elseif zone_name == self.runaway_zone_name and
			self.controller.current_quest_state == self.controller.vampire_quest_states.fight and
			self.quest_progress.InnerProgress == 1 and not self.quest_progress.IsComplete then
		coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.vampire_girl_runaway, self))
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:on_touch_event(e)
	if self.check_tap then
		if e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.TouchDown and self.time_since_last_tap_count > 0.3 then
			music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.jump_sfx_name)
			character_util.jump({user_party_leader, self.vampire_girl}, 0.4, 0.25)
			character_util.stop(user_party_leader, self.vampire_girl)

			local user_move_target = vector(user_party_leader.Position.x + self.jump_mod,
					user_party_leader.Position.y, user_party_leader.Position.z)

			character_util.move_waypoint(user_party_leader, user_move_target, 4.5, false,
					"stop", "free", "right")

			local vampire_girl_move_target = vector(self.vampire_girl.Position.x + self.jump_mod,
					self.vampire_girl.Position.y, self.vampire_girl.Position.z)

			character_util.move_waypoint(self.vampire_girl, vampire_girl_move_target, 4.5, false,
					"stop", "free", "left")

			self.jump_mod = self.jump_mod * -1
			self.time_since_last_tap_count = 0
			self.tap_count = self.tap_count + 1

			camera_util.shake(0.1, 0.1)
		end
	elseif e.TouchEventType == CS.Oak.TouchEventType.SwipeLeft then
		self.qte_cpmplete = true
	end

	return true
end

function local_class:vampire_girl_runaway()
	self.vampire_girl.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
	self.vampire_girl.Interactable = CS.Oak.NonInteractable.Instance

	local diff = user_party_leader.Position - self.vampire_girl.Position
	self.vampire_girl.Direction = diff:ToDirection()

	character_util.set_emotion(self.vampire_girl, { name = "tired" })

	coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.5))

	character_util.move_waypoint(self.vampire_girl, vector(66, 0, 2.5), 6.5,
			true, "stop", "floor", "left", true)

	character_util.set_anim(self.vampire_girl, { name = "run" })

	local movefinished = false

	field_ui_manager:Hide()
	self.vampire_girl:HideWeapon(true)
	character_util.set_position(self.vampire_girl, {69, 0, user_party_leader.Position.z})

function local_class:vampire_raid_process()

	local cury = self.vampire_girl.Position.y

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < raid_time do
		local normalized_time = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / raid_time

		freefall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
		local disty = freefall:GetDistance()

			break

		cury = self.vampire_girl.Position.y
		curz = self.vampire_girl.Position.z
		freefall = CS.CalculatorFreeFall(raid_time, 1.3, 0)

		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < raid_time do
			local normalized_time = (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / raid_time
			curx = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(startx, endx, normalized_time)

			freefall:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
			local disty = freefall:GetDistance()

			character_util.set_position(self.vampire_girl, {curx, cury + disty, curz}, true)

			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end

		character_util.set_position(self.vampire_girl, {endx, 0, curz})
	else
		music_player.StageBgmState = CS.Oak.StageBgmState.Muted
		self.audios_source_holder = music_player_util.play_sfx({
			sfx_name = self.pet_bite_sfx_name, loop = true, type_priority = "loop", player_priority = "npc"})

		music_player:PlaySfxOneShot(self.bomb_sfx_name)
		character_util.spine_pulse_color(user_party_leader, CS.Oak.Constants.DamageColor, 1, 0.3, 0.5)
		character_util.spine_damage_squish(user_party_leader, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 0.3)

		character_util.set_position(self.vampire_girl,
				{self.vampire_girl.Position.x, 1.75, self.vampire_girl.Position.z - 1})

		character_util.spine_rotate(self.vampire_girl, 30, 0.3)

		cur_time = unity_class.time.time
		local playerx = user_party_leader.Position.x
		local vampirex = self.vampire_girl.Position.x
		local friction = CS.CalculatorFrictionPush(0, user_party_leader.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.FieldObjectSpec.Mass,
				CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient, 2500, 0.4)
		local vampire_friction = CS.CalculatorFrictionPush(0, self.vampire_girl.FieldObjectStatsBehaviour.FieldObjectSpec.Mass,
				CS.Oak.Constants.DefaultFrictionCoefficient, 2500, 0.4)
		local friction_time = 0.3
		cury = self.vampire_girl.Position.y
		curz = self.vampire_girl.Position.z

		while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < friction_time do
			friction:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
			vampire_friction:Proceed(unity_class.time.deltaTime)
			local distx = friction:GetDistance()
			local vampire_distx = vampire_friction:GetDistance()

			character_util.set_position(user_party_leader,
					{playerx - distx, user_party_leader.Position.y,user_party_leader.Position.z})
			character_util.set_position(self.vampire_girl,{vampirex - vampire_distx, cury, curz})
			coroutine.yield(nil)
		end
	end
end

	character_util.spine_damage_squish(user_party_leader, 1.3, 0.7, 1, 1)
	character_util.shake(user_party_leader, 0.03, 2)
	character_util.set_direction(user_party_leader, "right")
	character_util.set_anim(user_party_leader, {name = "embarrassed"})
	character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = "surprised"})

	self.vampire_girl.SpineController:Shake(0.03, 2)
	self.vampire_girl:RemoveAnimation()
	character_util.set_anim(self.vampire_girl, {name = "eat"})
	character_util.set_emotion(self.vampire_girl, {name = "damaged"})
	camera_util.shake(0.05, 1000)

	message_system:Subscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent), 'on_event')
	self.listening_touch_event = true
	self.check_tap = true

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.ShowTurboTap(1)

	local total_time_passed = 0

	while true do
		self.time_since_last_tap_count = self.time_since_last_tap_count + unity_class.time.deltaTime
		total_time_passed = total_time_passed + unity_class.time.deltaTime

		if self.tap_count >= 7 or total_time_passed > 5 then
			self.audios_source_holder:FadeOut()
			music_player_util.play_stage_music({ state = 'field' })
			break
		end

		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end

	user_party_leader:RemoveAnimation()
	user_party_leader:RemoveEmotion()

	if self.time_since_last_tap_count < 0.3 then
		coroutine.yield(coroutine_class.wait_for_sec(0.3 - self.time_since_last_tap_count))
	end

	CS.Oak.CommonScreenplay.CloseTutorialSpine()

	message_system:Unsubscribe(self.controller, typeof(CS.Oak.TouchEvent))
	self.listening_touch_event = false
	self.check_tap = false

	stage_camera:CancelShake()
	stage_camera:ResizeTo(CS.Oak.StageCamera.DefaultCameraSize, 0.3)
	stage.Field:Undarken("qte", 0.3)

	coroutine.yield(nil)

	local cur_time = unity_class.time.time
	local startx = self.vampire_girl.Position.x
	local endx = user_party_leader.Position.x + 1
	local starty = self.vampire_girl.Position.y
	local endy = 0
	local startz = self.vampire_girl.Position.z
	local endz = 11.24

	while unity_class.time.time - cur_time < reset_duration do
		local curx = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(startx, endx, (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / reset_duration)
		local cury = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(starty, endy, (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / reset_duration)
		local curz = unity_class.mathf.Lerp(startz, endz, (unity_class.time.time - cur_time) / reset_duration)

		character_util.set_position(self.vampire_girl, {curx, cury, curz})
		coroutine.yield(nil)
	end
	character_util.set_position(self.vampire_girl, {endx, endy, endz})
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

end
