local local_class = newclass('XMasSkiFreeSection1')

--[[QuestAttribute
		Type = progress @
		QuestName = XMasSkiFree @
		Comment = 납치 당한 조난자를 돕고 스타피스 획득 @
		Index = 0 @
]]

function local_class:init(controller, quest_spec)
    self.controller = controller
    self.quest_spec = quest_spec

    self.battle_group_name = 'fat_yeti'

    self.enum = {
        -- 초기 상태
        none = 0,
        -- 이벤트 실행
        zone_entered = 1,
        -- 전투 시작
        fight = 2,
        -- 전투 종료
        fought = 3
    }
    self.progress = nil

    -- 플레이어가 배틀 존에 있는지 나타내는 플래그
    self.is_party_leader_in_battle = false

    self.start_zone_name = 'ski_free_enter_zone'
    self.battle_zone_name = 'ski_free_battle_zone'
end

function local_class:enter()
    if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_name then return true end

    message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent), 'on_zone_enter_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent), 'on_zone_leave_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent), 'on_battle_group_eliminated_event')
    message_system:Subscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent), 'on_damage_event')

    return true
end

function local_class:start()
    if stage.Name ~= self.controller.stage_name then return true end
    self.ski_free_dude = self.controller.get_ski_free_dude()
    self.ski_free_dude_dest_marker_pos = field:GetMarker('ski_free_dude_dest').position
    self.fat_yeti = self.controller.get_fat_yeti()
    self.fat_yeti_dest_marker_pos = field:GetMarker('fat_yeti_dest').position

    character_util.set_position(self.ski_free_dude, field:GetMarker('ski_free_dude').position)
    character_util.set_direction(self.ski_free_dude, 'left')

    character_util.set_position(self.fat_yeti, field:GetMarker('fat_yeti').position)
    character_util.set_direction(self.fat_yeti, 'left')

    self.progress = self.enum.none
end

function local_class:exit()
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneEnterEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.ZoneLeaveEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.BattleGroupEliminatedEvent))
    message_system:Unsubscribe(self, typeof(CS.Oak.DamageEvent))

    self.controller = nil
    self.quest_spec = nil
end

function local_class:dispose()
end

--region event related
function local_class:on_event(e)

    return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_enter_event(e)
    if e.FullEnter == false then return false end
    if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end
    local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

    if zone_name == self.start_zone_name and self.progress == self.enum.none then
        sp_util.play_normal_screenplay(self.take_ski_dude, self)
    elseif zone_name == self.battle_zone_name then
        self.is_party_leader_in_battle = true
        if self.progress == self.enum.zone_entered then
            coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.start_battle, self))
        end
    end
    return false
end

function local_class:on_zone_leave_event(e)
    if e.FullLeave == false then return false end
    if e.FieldObject ~= user_party_leader then return false end
    local zone_name = e.Zone.Name

    if zone_name == self.battle_zone_name then
        self.is_party_leader_in_battle = false
    end
    return false
end

function local_class:on_battle_group_eliminated_event(e)
    if e.BattleGroupName == self.battle_group_name then
        sp_util.play_battle_end_screenplay(self.defeat_yeti, self)
    end

    return false
end

function local_class:on_damage_event(e)
    if self.is_party_leader_in_battle == true then return false end

    if e.Info.target == self.fat_yeti then
        coroutine_manager:StartCoroutine(stage.StageGameObject, util.cs_generator(self.cancel_aggro, self))
    end
    return false
end
--endregion

--region custom function
function local_class:cancel_aggro()
    -- 예티 전투 종료
    message_system:Publish(CS.Oak.MonsterGiveUpEvent.Create(self.fat_yeti, self.battle_zone_name))
    -- 파티원 어그로 풀고 리더 따라가기
    for i = 1, user_party.Count - 1 do
        local clms = CS.Oak.CharacterControllerPartyFollowState.Create(user_party[i], user_party)
        user_party[i]:OnEvent(CS.Oak.StateChangeEvent.Create(clms))
    end
    coroutine.yield(nil)
    -- 예티 전투 스테이트 초기화
    self.fat_yeti:OnEvent(CS.Oak.ReturnToPatrolEvent.Instance)
end

function local_class:take_ski_dude()
    self.progress = self.enum.zone_entered
    character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.ski_free_dude, {name = 'prostrate'}, {name = 'tired'})

    self.ski_free_dude.SpineController:ForceUpdateSpines(unity_class.time.deltaTime * 2)

    camera_util.move_async(self.ski_free_dude.Position, 2)

    wait_for_sec(1)
    -- 사람...?
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.ski_free_dude, {key = 'xmas_ski_free_1', skip = true})
    wait_for_sec(0.5)
    --character_util.shake_and_wakeup(self.ski_free_dude, 'left', 1, nil)
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_rustle_01')
    character_util.shake(self.ski_free_dude, 0.02, 0.5)
    wait_for_sec(1)
    character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.ski_free_dude)
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_player_popup_01')
    character_util.mario_jump_async(self.ski_free_dude, 'left')

    wait_for_sec(1)
    -- 이런 곳에서 사람을 만나다니...
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.ski_free_dude, {key = 'xmas_ski_free_2', skip = true})
    -- 정말 다행이야.
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.ski_free_dude, {key = 'xmas_ski_free_3', skip = true})
    camera_util.shake(0.05, 0.5)
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_negative_01')
    -- 이봐! 내말 들려?
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.ski_free_dude, {key = 'xmas_ski_free_4', skip = true, bubble_type = 'shout',
            world_pos = self.ski_free_dude.Position + vector(-1, 0, 0)})
    -- 스키를 타다 정신을 차려보니 조난 당했어.
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.ski_free_dude, {key = 'xmas_ski_free_5', skip = true})
    -- 아무도 없는 곳에서 쓸쓸히 죽어 예티 밥이나 되는 줄 알았는데...
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.ski_free_dude, {key = 'xmas_ski_free_6', skip = true})
    character_util.set_emotion(self.ski_free_dude, {name = 'smile'})
    -- 예티 밥이라니 다시 생각해보니 말도 안...
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.ski_free_dude, {key = 'xmas_ski_free_7', force_sfx = true})
    wait_for_sec(1)

    camera_util.shake(0.07, math.huge)
    local earthquake_sfx = music_player_util.play_sfx({sfx_name = '01_earthquake_03', loop = true, fade_in_time = 2})
    character_util.show_emoticon(self.ski_free_dude, nil, 'question')
    wait_for_sec(1)
    character_util.remove_emotion(self.ski_free_dude)

    local yeti_origin_pos = self.fat_yeti.Position
    local yeti_waypoint_pos = self.ski_free_dude.Position + vector(1, 0, 0)
    character_util.move_waypoint(self.fat_yeti, yeti_waypoint_pos, 7,
            true, 'stop', 'floor', 'left')
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_golem_run_01')

    while yeti_waypoint_pos.x - self.fat_yeti.Position.x > 3 do
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    character_util.set_direction(self.ski_free_dude, 'right')
    character_util.set_emotion(self.ski_free_dude, {name = 'surprise'})
    character_util.set_emotion(user_party_leader, {name = 'surprise'})

    while yeti_waypoint_pos.x ~= self.fat_yeti.Position.x do
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end
    music_player:PlaySfxOneShot('02_fire_slash_03')
    character_util.set_anim(self.fat_yeti, {name = 'attack', loop = false, next_anim = 'get'})
    wait_for_sec(0.4)
    character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.fat_yeti)

    character_util.spine_rotate(self.ski_free_dude, 60, 0.3)
    character_util.move_waypoint(self.fat_yeti, yeti_origin_pos, 7,
            true, 'stop', 'floor', 'right')

    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('02_victim_scream_02')
    -- 으아아아아아악!!!
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble(self.ski_free_dude, {key = 'xmas_ski_free_8', bubble_type = 'shout'})
    while yeti_origin_pos.x ~= self.fat_yeti.Position.x do
        character_util.set_position(self.ski_free_dude, self.fat_yeti.Position + vector(-0.3, 0, 1.2))
        coroutine.yield(nil)
    end

    camera_util.return_to_leader(2)
    wait_for_sec(0.5)
    character_util.remove_emotion(user_party_leader)
    camera_util.cancel_shake()
    earthquake_sfx:FadeOut(2)
    wait_for_sec(1)

    character_util.set_position(self.fat_yeti, self.fat_yeti_dest_marker_pos + vector(2, 0, 0))
    character_util.set_direction(self.fat_yeti, 'right')
    character_util.remove_anim(self.fat_yeti)

    character_util.spine_rotate(self.ski_free_dude, 0, 0.3)
    character_util.set_position(self.ski_free_dude, self.ski_free_dude_dest_marker_pos)
    character_util.set_direction(self.ski_free_dude, 'left')
    character_util.set_anim_and_emotion(self.ski_free_dude, {name = 'idle'}, {name = 'scared'})
    self.ski_free_dude.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.EtherealCrashBehaviour.Instance
end

function local_class:start_battle()
    self.progress = self.enum.fight
    field_ui_manager:Hide()
    party_util.stop_and_disable_control()

    camera_util.move_async(self.fat_yeti.Position + vector(-4, 0, 0), 1)
    character_util.shake(self.ski_free_dude, 0.03, math.huge)
    wait_for_sec(0.5)
    character_util.show_emoticon(self.fat_yeti, nil, 'notice')
    wait_for_sec(1)
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('01_swing_01')
    character_util.set_direction(self.fat_yeti, 'left')
    character_util.set_direction(self.fat_yeti, 'left')
    wait_for_sec(0.5)

    camera_util.return_to_leader(1)
    party_util.reset_controllers()
    field_ui_manager:Show()

    character_util.convert_to_monster(self.fat_yeti, self.battle_group_name, self.battle_zone_name)
    command_util.execute_monster_notice(self.fat_yeti, user_party_leader, "battle")
end

function local_class:defeat_yeti()
    self.progress = self.enum.fought
    self.is_party_leader_in_battle = false
    self.ski_free_dude.CrashBehaviour = CS.Oak.NPCCrashBehaviour.Instance
    wait_for_sec(1)

    -- 현재 타겟과 떨어진 거리에 맞게 파티 얼라인 속도 조절
    local dis = math.sqrt(user_party_leader.Position:SqrDistance(self.ski_free_dude.Position))
    local speed = 4
    local duration = dis / speed
    duration = duration < 1.5 and 1.5 or duration
    party_util.align_to_target(self.ski_free_dude, 'left', duration)
    character_util.remove_anim_and_emotion(self.ski_free_dude)
    character_util.stop_shake(self.ski_free_dude)

    wait_for_sec(1)
    music_player_util.play_sfx_one_shot('03_dialogue_sadness_01')
    -- 정말 고마워, 정말로 예티가 날 먹는 줄 알았어.
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.ski_free_dude, {key = 'xmas_ski_free_9', skip = true})
    character_util.set_emotion(self.ski_free_dude, {name = 'tired'})
    -- 할아버지, 아버지 전부 스키를 타다 행방불명 됐는데.
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.ski_free_dude, {key = 'xmas_ski_free_10', skip = true})
    -- 어머니는 모두 예티한테 먹힌거라고 했어.
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.ski_free_dude, {key = 'xmas_ski_free_11', skip = true})
    -- 그게 정말이라니...
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.ski_free_dude, {key = 'xmas_ski_free_12', skip = true})
    -- 이제 스키 따윈 쳐다보지도 말아야지.
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.ski_free_dude, {key = 'xmas_ski_free_13', skip = true})
    character_util.remove_emotion(self.ski_free_dude)
    -- 참, 산속을 헤맬 때 예쁜 돌을 주웠는데, 이거 줄게
    speech_bubble_util.show_speech_bubble_async(self.ski_free_dude, {key = 'xmas_ski_free_14', skip = true})

    local star_piece = self.controller.get_star_piece()
    star_piece_util.appear(star_piece, self.ski_free_dude.Position + vector(0, 0.5, 0.5),
            user_party_leader.Position + vector(0, 0, -1))

    wait_for_sec(2)
    -- 이제 스키 따윈 쳐다보지도 말아야지.
    self.ski_free_dude.Interactable.Talk = 'xmas_ski_free_13'

    yield_return_func(quest_util.complete_quest, self.controller, 0, true, false, false)
end
--endregion

return local_class
